title: Statistical Gauge Theory of Structural Glasses: Equilibrium Scenarios and Glass-Forming Ability
summary: The model primarily concerns structural glasses described by systems of topological defects. We explore the scope of this approach and investigate equilibrium behavior within the mean-field approximation. Our analysis reveals three possible equilibrium scenarios, only one of which exhibits a strong glass-forming ability. These scenarios allow for the phenomenological selection of model parameters based on equilibrium behavior, which can then be used to study dynamics during quenching. We identify an upper temperature limit beyond which quenching into the glassy state becomes impossible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由拓扑缺陷系统描述的结构玻璃模型，在平均场近似下分析其平衡行为，揭示了三种可能的平衡情景，其中仅一种表现出强玻璃形成能力。基于平衡行为可对模型参数进行唯象选择，并用于研究淬火过程中的动力学行为，同时确定了淬火进入玻璃态的上限温度。
AI.motivation: 探索以拓扑缺陷系统描述结构玻璃这一方法的适用范围，并理解其平衡行为与玻璃形成能力之间的关系，为玻璃模型参数的选取和动力学研究提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用平均场近似方法研究拓扑缺陷系统中结构玻璃的平衡行为，通过分析不同的平衡情景来筛选模型参数，并进一步研究淬火过程中的动力学行为。
AI.result: 发现三种可能的平衡情景，其中仅一种展现出强玻璃形成能力；确定了基于平衡行为进行参数选择的方案，并识别出淬火进入玻璃态存在一个上限温度。
AI.conclusion: 该拓扑缺陷方法在特定参数范围内可有效描述结构玻璃的平衡行为，且平衡行为可为动力学淬火研究提供参数选择的指导，但淬火过程受上限温度限制。

title: Curvature-amplified angular localization of radially localized states
summary: We study a continuum Schrödinger particle on a surface of constant curvature subject to a radial random potential and a weaker angle-dependent perturbation. Exact angular-momentum decomposition reduces the rotationally symmetric problem to independent one-dimensional random radial channels. A positive radial Lyapunov exponent distinguishes radial Anderson localization from the circular probability profile imposed by symmetry. Projection of a narrow radial mode produces a disordered one-dimensional ring. For angular disorder that is stationary in physical arc length, the ring localization length grows as the inverse square of the perturbation amplitude. Equating this length with the geodesic circumference yields a shell-breaking radius that grows algebraically in flat space but as $2a\ln(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ on a hyperbolic surface of curvature radius $a$ and angular-disorder amplitude $\varepsilon$. Transfer-matrix and finite-ring calculations determine the crossover coefficient. Direct polar-grid calculations at the same angular energy as the ring model use unbiased tracking of the degenerate angular-momentum subspace across six independent radial-disorder realizations and quantify the validity of the single-mode projection. The noncommuting weak-disorder and flat-curvature limits establish a curvature-amplified crossover for this deliberately anisotropic disorder ensemble, rather than a generic metal--insulator transition on the hyperbolic plane.

AI.tldr: 本文研究常曲率曲面上的连续薛定谔粒子，受径向随机势和较弱的角度依赖微扰作用。通过角动量分解将旋转对称问题化为独立的一维随机径向通道，正径向Lyapunov指数区分径向安德森局域化与对称性决定的圆形概率分布。窄径向模式投影产生无序一维环，环局域化长度随微扰振幅平方反比增长。将局域化长度与测地线周长相比较，得到壳破裂半径：在平坦空间中代数增长，在双曲曲面（曲率半径a、角向无序振幅ε）上为2a ln(1/ε)+O(1)。传递矩阵和有限环计算确定交叉系数，极坐标网格计算通过六次独立径向无序实现验证单模投影的有效性。弱无序与平坦曲率极限的不可交换性确立了曲率放大交叉而非双曲平面上的通用金属-绝缘体转变。
AI.motivation: 探索曲面曲率（特别是负曲率/双曲几何）对安德森局域化现象的影响，理解在具有角度依赖微扰的各向异性无序系综中，曲率如何放大或改变局域化交叉行为，并研究平坦与弯曲空间极限的非交换性。
AI.method: 采用严格的角动量分解将旋转对称径向随机问题化为独立一维随机径向通道；利用径向Lyapunov指数表征局域化；将窄径向模式投影为一维无序环模型；通过传递矩阵与有限环计算确定交叉系数；采用极坐标网格直接数值计算，在六个独立径向无序实现中无偏追踪简并角动量子空间，验证单模投影的有效性。
AI.result: 角向无序（在物理弧长上平稳）的环局域化长度与微扰振幅平方成反比。壳破裂半径在平坦空间代数增长，在双曲曲面上为2a ln(1/ε)+O(1)。数值计算给出了交叉系数并量化了单模投影的适用范围，确认弱无序与平曲率极限不可交换。
AI.conclusion: 该体系展现出曲率放大的各向异性交叉行为，而非双曲平面上的通用金属-绝缘体转变。双曲几何使壳破裂半径呈对数增长，体现了曲率对无序效应的显著放大作用。

title: Boundary Kerr Signatures of the Interband-Coherence Hall Effect
summary: We identify a Hall response carried by optically induced interband coherence rather than by a non-equilibrium band population. In a weakly doped zinc-blende semiconductor, a longitudinal dc field drives a transverse flux of the conduction--valence coherence created by near-gap light. Angular averaging eliminates the homogeneous coherence density, while a lateral boundary converts the transverse flux into an antisymmetric, edge-localized, helicity-odd polarization. The resulting Kerr signal requires neither spin-orbit coupling nor a spin, valley, or orbital accumulation within an individual band. Within the eight-band Kane model, we derive the boundary kinetic equation and obtain a complex propagation length controlled by optical detuning and interband dephasing. The edge profile is monotonic at optical resonance and develops damped spatial oscillations away from it. The response is enhanced by electron--hole asymmetry and by strong interband mixing, making narrow-gap semiconductors especially favorable to observe the effect. These results establish dc-driven Kerr microscopy as a direct probe of an interband-coherence Hall effect and of multiband quantum kinetics in real space.

AI.tldr: 本文在弱掺杂闪锌矿半导体中发现了一种由光致带间相干而非非平衡带 population 所承载的霍尔响应：纵向直流电场驱动近带隙光产生的导带-价带相干在横向产生通量，在边界处转化为反对称、边缘局域、螺旋度奇异的偏振，从而产生无需自旋轨道耦合的Kerr信号。
AI.motivation: 现有的Hall效应研究大多聚焦于带内（intraband）载流子或带间population的不对称分布，缺乏对带间相干性（interband coherence）是否也能承载横向输运响应的深入研究。作者旨在揭示一种全新的物理机制——由光学激发的带间相干而非带内布居所驱动的霍尔效应。
AI.method: 基于八带Kane模型，推导了边界动力学方程（boundary kinetic equation），分析了直流场作用下近带隙光激发的导带-价带相干的横向通量；通过角向平均消除均匀相干密度，并利用横向边界将相干通量转化为边缘局域的反对称偏振分布，得到复数传播长度，其受光学失谐和带间退相干控制。
AI.result: 发现Kerr信号在光学共振处呈单调边缘分布，远离共振时出现阻尼空间振荡；响应强度随电子-空穴不对称性和带间混和增强而增大，因此窄带隙半导体尤为有利于观测该效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了直流驱动Kerr显微术作为带间相干霍尔效应及实空间多带量子动力学的直接探测手段，拓展了对霍尔响应基本机制的理解，无需自旋轨道耦合即可实现光学探测。

title: Exponential Capacity in Multilayer Hetero-Associative Neural Networks
summary: Exponential Hopfield networks store a number of patterns that grows exponentially with the number of neurons, and in their classical formulation they are auto-associative: they complete a corrupted copy of a memory into the memory itself. Many of the tasks one wants such a network to perform are instead hetero-associative, mapping a cue to a different target. We introduce and analyse an exponential neural network of $L$ layers of $N$ binary neurons, each layer carrying its own dataset, whose energy is an exponential of the product of the per-layer Mattis overlaps, so that it is minimised precisely when every layer retrieves the pattern of the same index; the stored association must be a surjective function of the cue, and we show why nothing else can be stored at all. A cavity/signal-to-noise analysis, made exact at leading order by a large-deviation evaluation of the noise, shows that the aligned hetero-associative state is a fixed point of the zero-temperature dynamics up to a number of stored patterns $P_c\sim e^{Nρ_L}$, exponential in the layer size, with an explicit rate $ρ_L$ that grows like $L\log 2$; enlarging the basins of attraction lowers the rate but never destroys its exponential character. Comparing the theory with structured data we find that the exponential capacity and the predicted basins survive correlated, many-to-one patterns: the network is a near-perfect content-addressable memory. The same closed forms describe, without refitting, a synthetic manifold, real T-cell-receptor/epitope triples and natural-language intent data, so the mechanism is domain-universal. Generalisation to unseen cues, though significantly above chance, stays below memorisation, and it is the geometry of the encoding, rather than the data domain, that sets how far above chance it reaches. In this family, exponential storage and strong generalisation are distinct capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种多层指数Hopfield网络，用于异联想记忆任务（将线索映射到不同目标）。该网络能量为各层Mattis重叠乘积的指数函数，能以指数级容量存储关联模式，且通过空腔/信噪比分析证明其对齐的异联想状态是零温动力学的固定点，存储容量P_c~e^{Nρ_L}随层数L增长，容量率ρ_L≈L log2。该方法在结构化数据（真实T细胞受体/表位数据、自然语言意图数据）上同样有效，但泛化能力仍低于记忆能力，说明指数存储与强泛化是两种不同能力。
AI.motivation: 经典指数Hopfield网络是自联想记忆模型，只能完成"从损坏副本恢复原记忆"的任务，但实际许多任务需要异联想（hetero-associative）映射，即从线索映射到不同的目标模式。现有异联想记忆网络缺乏指数级的存储容量分析，因此需要构建并严格分析一种能够同时具备指数容量和异联想能力的神经记忆网络。
AI.method: 构建L层、每层N个二进制神经元的指数网络，其能量是各层Mattis重叠乘积的指数函数，能量最小化恰好对应每层检索到相同索引的模式。理论分析采用空腔/信噪比方法，通过大偏差估计噪声的前导阶使分析在领头阶精确。证明对齐的异联想状态是零温动力学固定点，并推导存储容量率ρ_L随L增长（约L log2）。同时在合成流形、真实T细胞受体/表位三元组和自然语言意图数据上验证理论闭合形式。
AI.result: 网络在P_c~e^{Nρ_L}个存储模式内，异联想状态是零温动力学的固定点，容量率ρ_L随层数L线性增长约L log2。扩大吸引域会降低容量率但不破坏其指数特性。在结构化、多对一的关联数据上，指数容量和预测的吸引域依然成立，网络接近完美的内容可寻址记忆。泛化到未见线索显著高于随机水平但仍低于记忆水平，泛化上限取决于编码几何而非数据域。
AI.conclusion: 该多层指数Hopfield网络实现了异联想任务的指数级存储容量，且机制具有领域普适性。指数存储与强泛化在该网络家族中是分离的能力，网络擅长记忆但泛化有限，泛化水平由编码几何结构决定。

title: Accelerated Random-Sweep Gibbs Sampling for Gaussian Graphical Models via Dual Normal Factor Graphs
summary: We study the convergence properties of the random-sweep Gibbs sampler for Gaussian graphical models with a thin-membrane prior. We demonstrate that the convergence rate of the Gibbs sampler is significantly accelerated in the dual model, which is obtained by applying the Fourier transform to the local factors of the normal factor graph representing the original model. In both domains, we derive the exact convergence rates for homogeneous $k$-regular graphs. We prove that, for all homogeneous models whose graphical representations contain cycles, the convergence rate in the dual domain is universal and independent of the underlying graph topology. Moreover, we show that the effective convergence rate in the dual domain is governed by the algebraic connectivity of the graph, providing an additional acceleration without increasing the computational complexity per sweep. We further establish an explicit algebraic relation between the covariance structures of the primal and dual models, enabling marginal statistics of the primal model to be recovered directly from those of the dual model. Finally, numerical experiments on several graph families confirm our theoretical results and demonstrate substantial improvements in the convergence rates in various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有薄膜先验的高斯图模型中随机扫描Gibbs采样的收敛性质，证明通过对normal factor graph局部因子施加傅里叶变换得到的对偶模型能显著加速Gibbs采样收敛。作者推导了同质k-正则图的精确收敛率，证明含环同质模型在对偶域的收敛率具有拓扑无关的普适性，并揭示收敛率由图的代数连通性主导。此外还建立了原始与对偶模型协方差结构间的显式代数关系，使得原始模型边际统计量可直接从对偶模型中恢复。
AI.motivation: Gibbs采样是贝叶斯推断中广泛使用的MCMC方法，但在某些模型（如高斯图模型）中收敛速度可能很慢。本文的动机在于探索是否可以通过某种变换（如傅里叶变换）构造对偶模型，从而在不增加计算复杂度的前提下显著加速Gibbs采样的收敛，并给出理论上的收敛率分析。
AI.method: 本文方法包括：(1) 利用normal factor graph表示高斯图模型，通过对局部因子施加傅里叶变换构造对偶模型；(2) 推导同质k-正则图在原始域和对偶域中随机扫描Gibbs采样的精确收敛率；(3) 利用代数图论（代数连通性）刻画对偶域中收敛率的普适性；(4) 建立原始与对偶模型协方差结构之间的显式代数关系，支持从对偶模型中直接恢复原始模型的边际统计量。
AI.result: (1) 对偶域中Gibbs采样收敛率显著加速；(2) 对所有含环的同质模型，对偶域收敛率具有普适性，不依赖具体图拓扑；(3) 有效收敛率由图的代数连通性主导，且不增加每次扫描的计算复杂度；(4) 通过数值实验在多种图族上验证了理论结果，展示了收敛率的实质性提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了傅里叶变换构造的对偶模型能够在不增加计算开销的前提下显著加速Gibbs采样收敛，为大规模高斯图模型的高效贝叶斯推断提供了一种理论保证的新途径。收敛率与代数连通性的联系为图结构设计与采样加速的交叉研究开辟了方向。

title: Multistability and state-switching in series-coupled resonant tunneling diodes
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures, submitted to Advanced Physics Research (Wiley)
summary: Resonant tunneling diodes (RTDs) embedded in an electrical circuit are known for their neuron-like response characteristics, which makes them promising candidates for neuromorphic applications. This paper investigates the dynamical response of series-coupled RTDs and systematically analyzes the impact of coupling and inhomogeneities on the solution structure. We further propose a scheme for controlled switching between coexisting stable states which allows to realize tunable memory elements in these circuits. The coupled RTD system exhibits a rich bifurcation structure, showing different degrees of multistability between symmetric and antisymmetric solutions. Limit-cycle branches and their dependence on the system parameters are analyzed using numerical continuation methods. A central focus is placed on the role of symmetry. For two identical RTDs, the system possesses a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ exchange symmetry, which governs the emergence of symmetry-breaking bifurcations and multistable states. The analysis is further generalized to $N$ coupled RTDs, revealing the underlying $S_N$ symmetry structure and its influence on the organization of equilibrium branches, paving the way for neuromorphic network operation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了串联耦合谐振隧穿二极管（RTD）电路的动力学响应，分析了耦合强度和不均匀性对解结构的影响，提出了在共存稳定态间受控切换的方案以实现可调谐存储元件，并揭示了系统由Z2（两器件）到SN（N器件）对称群支配的丰富分岔结构和多稳态特性。
AI.motivation: RTD嵌入电路后展现出类神经元响应特性，是神经形态计算的有力候选，但串联耦合RTD系统的动力学行为（特别是耦合与不均匀性对解结构的影响）尚未被系统理解，这限制了其在可调谐存储元件和神经形态网络中的应用。
AI.method: 采用数值延拓（numerical continuation）方法分析耦合RTD系统的分岔结构；利用群论对称性分析（Z2交换对称性和SN对称群）解释对称性破缺分岔与多稳态的组织规律；提出在共存稳定态之间进行受控切换的方案。
AI.result: 耦合RTD系统展现出丰富的分岔结构，在对称与反对称解之间呈现不同程度的多稳态；极限环分支对系统参数的依赖性被完整刻画；两RTD系统的Z2对称性支配对称性破缺分岔的产生，N个RTD系统的SN对称结构决定了平衡分支的组织方式。
AI.conclusion: 对称性分析为理解和控制耦合RTD电路的动力学提供了统一框架，所提出的受控切换方案可实现可调谐存储元件，SN对称结构为进一步设计神经形态网络操作奠定了基础。

title: Gapped Parent Hamiltonians for the Strongly Deformed Toric Code
summary: Local non-unitary deformations of topologically ordered wavefunctions can drive transitions into peculiar states that challenge modern perspectives on gapped quantum matter. The strongly deformed toric code offers a curious case, hosting $m$ anyon condensation alongside perimeter-law scaling of Wilson loops charged under an exact 1-form symmetry---properties that typically do not coexist in gapped ground states. Nevertheless, we rigorously construct local gapped parent Hamiltonians for these strongly deformed toric code states. The Hamiltonians we construct are not strictly finite-range, but contain sums of Wilson loop operators whose coefficients decay exponentially in their diameter. If one adopts standard locality bounds used to define gapped phases---which allow for such exponentially decaying terms---our construction shows that these states realize a trivial gapped phase. Within this locality class, we demonstrate that perimeter-law scaling of Wilson loops does not imply a spontaneously broken 1-form symmetry, and from a dual perspective, that long-range ferromagnetic order and perimeter-law disorder parameter correlations can coexist in a 2D gapped ground state. We evade a recent no-go theorem [Sahay et al., arXiv:2503.01977] by relaxing its assumptions in a manner that we quantify as benign in the thermodynamic limit. More broadly, our results highlight that stronger notions of locality are necessary for prohibiting these counterintuitive properties within a gapped phase.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了强变形toric code态的局域有能隙母哈密顿量，证明在允许指数衰减项的局域性定义下，这些具有m任意子凝聚和威尔逊环周长律标度的态实际处于平凡的拓扑相。文章表明周长律标度并不必然意味着1-形式对称性自发破缺，并指出需要更强的局域性概念才能禁止这些反直觉性质在有能隙相中出现。
AI.motivation: 强变形toric code态同时表现出m任意子凝聚和1-形式对称性下的威尔逊环周长律标度，这两个性质在通常的有能隙基态中不共存。作者希望理解这些奇异态是否属于合法的有能隙量子物质，以及它们处于何种拓扑相，同时回应此前关于此类态的no-go定理。
AI.method: 作者严格构造了这些强变形toric code态的局域有能隙母哈密顿量。所构造的哈密顿量不是严格有限程的，而是包含威尔逊环算符的求和，其系数随环的直径指数衰减。作者将这种指数衰减视为标准局域性界限所允许的，并在该框架内分析态的相性质以及对称性破缺的判定。
AI.result: 1) 在这些强变形态可构造局域有能隙母哈密顿量；2) 在允许指数衰减项的局域性类中，这些态属于平凡有能隙相；3) 周长律标度的威尔逊环并不蕴含1-形式对称性的自发破缺；4) 对偶地，2D有能隙基态中可以同时存在长程铁磁序和周长律的失序参量关联；5) 通过放宽Sahay等人的no-go定理假设（在热力学极限下被量化为温和的），成功地规避了该定理。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：标准的局域性定义（允许指数衰减项）过于宽松，无法禁止周长律标度和任意子凝聚这类反直觉性质在有能隙相中共存。更强、更严格的局域性概念是必要的，以便对有能隙量子相的边界做出更明确的限定。这为理解拓扑序的稳定性与形变提供了新的视角。

title: Deriving the second law of thermodynamics and exploring its boundaries
summary: The second law of thermodynamics still lacks a general proof applicable to both classical and quantum systems across broad ranges of time scales, interactions, and degrees of nonequilibrium. In this paper, we show that when the macrostate-level probability $f$ of an isolated system increases monotonically with the number of possible microstates $Ω$ (i.e., $\partial f/\partial Ω> 0$), the second law emerges naturally from the continuity equation of $f$ in phase space; a special case of $\partial f/\partial Ω> 0$ is Boltzmann's assumption of equal a priori equilibrium probabilities. Based on this finding, the second law can be readily derived for fully chaotic systems. The derivation does not rely on dynamical details, highlighting the statistical nature of entropy increase. In contrast, for a locally nonchaotic system, the positive correlation between $f$ and $Ω$ may break down (i.e., $\partial f/\partial Ω\leq 0$). Consequently, the conventional framework of thermodynamics does not apply, and entropy can decrease spontaneously without any energetic penalty.

AI.tldr: 本文证明当孤立系统宏观状态概率f随微观状态数Ω单调递增（∂f/∂Ω>0）时，热力学第二定律可自然地由f在相空间中的连续性方程导出；该推导不依赖动力学细节，揭示了熵增的统计本质。反之，对于局部非混沌系统，这一正相关性可能破坏（∂f/∂Ω≤0），导致熵可无能量代价地自发降低。
AI.motivation: 热力学第二定律至今缺乏一个能同时适用于经典与量子系统、涵盖广泛时间尺度、相互作用程度和非平衡程度的普适证明，这一根本性缺失亟待填补。
AI.method: 作者提出一个关键条件：宏观水平概率f随可能微观状态数Ω单调递增（∂f/∂Ω>0），玻尔兹曼等先验概率假设是此条件的特例。基于该条件，从f在相空间中的连续性方程出发推导第二定律，并分别讨论全混沌系统与局部非混沌系统两种情形。
AI.result: 在∂f/∂Ω>0条件下，第二定律可对全混沌系统直接导出，且推导不依赖动力学的具体细节。而对于局部非混沌系统，f与Ω的正相关性可能失效（∂f/∂Ω≤0），此时传统热力学框架不再适用，熵可以自发减小且无需任何能量代价。
AI.conclusion: 第二定律的成立本质上基于统计层面f与Ω的正相关关系，而非具体的动力学机制；其普适性受限于系统是否满足该统计条件，非混沌系统中的熵减现象挑战了传统热力学框架的适用范围。

title: Experimental Demonstration of a Measurement-Feedback Quantum Information Engine
summary: Harnessing quantum inner friction in a finite-time stroke of quantum engine to extract work remains an open experimental challenge. Here we address this issue by experimentally establishing and demonstrating an innovative measurement-feedback quantum information engine model in the trapped 40Ca+ ion system, where the projective measurement replaces the hot reservoir as a nonthermal energy source and feedback-control conditionally steers the system through either unitary compression-expansion strokes or thermalization. We experimentally show that the engine, starting from arbitrary initial states, converges to a stable operating regime with a fully resolved energetic balance, and by controlling the measurement angle and stroke duration, the measurement-induced coherence and quantum inner friction can act as tunable resources to enhance the efficiency of engine beyond the Otto limit. The experimental results further demonstrate that the quantum inner friction can be utilized to break the traditional efficiency-power trade-off relation to synchronously achieve the high efficiency and large power. Our experiment establishes a route toward information-to-work quantum engines that convert finite-time irreversibility into performance-enhancing resources.

AI.tldr: 该论文在陷阱40Ca+离子系统中实验实现了一种测量-反馈量子信息引擎，利用量子内摩擦作为可调资源，在有限时间内超越奥托极限并打破效率-功率权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 在有限时间冲程中利用量子内摩擦从量子引擎中提取功仍是一个开放性实验挑战，作者旨在通过实验验证测量-反馈量子信息引擎模型来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 在陷阱40Ca+离子系统中构建测量-反馈量子信息引擎，用投影测量替代热库作为非热能来源，通过反馈控制条件性引导系统经历幺正压缩-膨胀冲程或热化过程，并调节测量角度与冲程持续时间来控制测量诱导相干性和量子内摩擦。
AI.result: 实验表明引擎从任意初始态收敛到稳定运行区域并具有完全解析的能量平衡；通过控制测量角度和冲程持续时间，测量诱导相干性与量子内摩擦可作为可调资源将引擎效率提升至超越奥托极限；量子内摩擦可用于打破传统的效率-功率权衡关系，同步实现高效率与大功率。
AI.conclusion: 该实验建立了通向信息-功量子引擎的路径，证明有限时间不可逆性可以转化为性能增强的资源。

title: Quantum Resources in Disorder-Free Localization Dynamics of Gauge Theories
comment: 13+8 pages (including End Matter and Supplemental Material), 5+1 figures, 1+2 tables
summary: Quantum-state complexity diagnostics provide valuable insight into many-body dynamics, information scrambling, and quantum computation. Here, we investigate the real-time dynamics of quantum complexity in $1+1$-dimensional Abelian U(1) and non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theories (LGTs), focusing on the disorder-free localization (DFL) regime. Using stabilizer Rényi entropy, participation Rényi entropy, and fermionic non-Gaussianity as measures of complexity, we observe, for both theories, two main behaviors as a function of the gauge coupling: at intermediate values, a power-law relaxation towards saturation, consistent with observations in many-body localization, and, at sufficiently large values, an ultraslow double-logarithmic growth, which we substantiate with a configuration-space bound verified by exact counting. Our results not only provide deeper insight into the dynamics of DFL but also highlight the role of gauge invariance in constraining quantum resources and are relevant to recent quantum simulations of LGTs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了1+1维阿贝尔U(1)和非阿贝尔SU(2)格点规范理论在无无序局域化（DFL）区域的量子复杂度实时动力学，利用稳定子Rényi熵、参与Rényi熵和费米子非高斯性作为复杂度度量，发现随规范耦合强度的不同可分为两种行为：中等耦合下呈幂律弛豫至饱和，大耦合下呈超慢的双对数增长，并通过精确计数验证了构型空间界。
AI.motivation: 量子态复杂度诊断能为多体动力学、信息扰乱和量子计算提供重要见解，但格点规范理论中的复杂度动力学——尤其是在DFL区域——尚未得到充分研究。作者旨在揭示规范不变性如何约束量子资源，并为近期格点规范理论的量子模拟提供理论指导。
AI.method: 作者对1+1维U(1)和SU(2)格点规范理论在DFL区域的实时动力学进行数值研究。具体使用三种互补的复杂度度量：稳定子Rényi熵、参与Rényi熵以及费米子非高斯性，系统扫描规范耦合强度，并通过精确计数方法验证所提出的构型空间上界。
AI.result: 在两种规范理论中均观察到两类主要行为：中等规范耦合下，复杂度呈幂律弛豫并趋于饱和，这与多体局域化中的观测一致；在足够大的耦合下，复杂度呈超慢的双对数增长，该行为由经精确计数验证的构型空间界所支持。
AI.conclusion: 该研究深化了对DFL动力学的理解，揭示了规范不变性在约束量子资源中的关键作用，为格点规范理论的量子模拟提供了有价值的理论参考。

title: Conditioning Tree-Based Diffusions and Flows for Probabilistic Tabular Regression
summary: Tree-based diffusion models fit flexible conditional predictive distributions for tabular regression without a neural density estimator, but they inherit their design defaults---noising path, parameterization, training distribution, features, sampler---from the neural setting. We show these defaults are the binding constraint: what a gradient-boosted ensemble actually solves is a supervised regression problem whose conditioning they determine. We present DiffGBM, which makes them explicit along two axes. First, a Gaussian-path flow-matching trainer for $p(y \mid x)$ that learns a velocity field directly and recovers the score algebraically, admitting few-step deterministic ODE sampling. Second, we expose the score-side recipe---residualization, EDM-style preconditioning, log-sigma time sampling, noise-level features, loss weighting, and histogram resolution---as jointly tunable axes over a shared LightGBM surface rather than one frozen bundle. This \emph{score-flex} space represents the published recipe as a special case; across eleven tabular benchmarks under fold-0 tuning, folds-1--5 evaluation, and a matched 40-trial budget and sampler, the selected configurations beat that baseline on \emph{every} dataset (paired Wilcoxon $11/0$, $p<10^{-3}$), with the best aggregate CRPS skill (0.725 vs.\ 0.699) of any row. The two rows are complementary: score-flex buys accuracy with a stochastic sampler and is the slowest row, while flow matching is the cheapest sampler ($5.2\times$ faster than the published baseline) and the best-calibrated DiffGBM row. Tuned non-diffusion baselines still win individual datasets, and stochastic ($\varepsilon>0$) flow samplers do not Pareto-dominate the deterministic corner.

AI.tldr: DiffGBM是一种基于树的扩散模型，用于表格数据回归中的条件预测分布建模。论文发现梯度提升集成实际求解的监督回归问题的调节方式由默认设计决定，因此提出了两条改进轴：一是基于高斯路径流匹配的训练器，直接学习速度场并代数恢复分数，支持少步确定性ODE采样；二是将分数侧配置（残差化、EDM预处理、log-sigma时间采样、噪声级特征、损失加权、直方图分辨率）作为联合可调轴。在11个表格基准上，调优配置在每项数据集上均优于发布基线（配对Wilcoxon 11/0），流匹配是最便宜的采样器（比基线快5.2倍）且标定最佳。
AI.motivation: 树-based扩散模型无需神经网络密度估计器即可为表格回归拟合灵活的条件预测分布，但它们继承了神经设定中的设计默认值（噪声路径、参数化、训练分布、特征、采样器）。论文表明这些默认值是约束瓶颈：梯度提升集成实际上解决的是一个受调节的监督回归问题，而这些默认设置决定了其调节方式。作者旨在将这些隐藏的设计选择显式化并系统化调优。
AI.method: DiffGBM提出两个方面的改进。(1) 高斯路径流匹配训练器：直接学习条件分布p(y|x)的速度场，并代数方式恢复分数，支持少步确定性ODE采样。(2) 分数侧配置空间（score-flex）：将残差化、EDM风格预处理、log-sigma时间采样、噪声级特征、损失加权和直方图分辨率作为在共享LightGBM表面上的联合可调超参数轴，使已发表的配方成为该空间的特殊情况。
AI.result: 在11个表格基准上，采用fold-0调优、fold-1到5评估、匹配40次试验预算和采样器的设置下，选中的配置在每项数据集上均优于发布基线（配对Wilcoxon检验11/0，p<0.001）。最佳聚合CRPS技能为0.725对比0.699。score-flex配合随机采样器换取精度但速度最慢；流匹配是最便宜的采样器（比已发布基线快5.2倍）且是标定最好的DiffGBM行。调优后的非扩散基线仍能赢得个别数据集，随机（ε>0）流采样器并未Pareto支配确定性角落。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了扩散模型设计默认值在树基框架中是主要瓶颈，通过在分数侧和流匹配两个轴上进行系统化的显式设计与调优，DiffGBM实现了在准确性和计算效率之间的灵活权衡。确定性采样器在Pareto意义上不被随机采样器支配，且流匹配在速度和标定方面具有独特优势。

title: Inverse Design of Multi-Layered Manufacturable Pixelated Diplexers Through Optimized Geometrical Configuration and Meshing Strategy in MoM
summary: This paper presents a fast inverse design framework for complex multilayered, multiport pixelated surfaces - a class of structures largely unexplored in current research. Leveraging a method-of-moments (MoM) electromagnetic (EM) solver, the framework enables the rapid synthesis of pixelated device designs. A novel matrix reconstruction technique, based on pre-labeling matrix entries as "inter-pixel" or "inner-pixel," accelerates simulations for each variation of the pixelated structure. To mitigate the cubic increase in computation time associated with additional layers, GPU acceleration is employed. Further enhancing convergence speed, a stochastic multi-pixel flipping search algorithm is integrated into the framework. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through the design of a diplexer achieving a -3-dB bandwidth for one channel spanning 5.23-5.94 GHz and another covering 6.17-7.15 GHz, validated by a full-wave solver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对复杂多层、多端口像素化表面的快速逆设计框架，结合矩量法（MoM）电磁求解器、基于预标签的矩阵重构技术、GPU加速及随机多像素翻转搜索算法，实现了像素化设备的高速合成。通过设计一个双工器验证了该框架的有效性，其两个通道的-3 dB带宽分别为5.23-5.94 GHz和6.17-7.15 GHz。
AI.motivation: 多层、多端口像素化表面是一类在当前研究中尚未被充分探索的结构，现有设计方法计算效率低下，难以快速实现此类复杂结构的逆设计，因此亟需一种高效的合成框架。
AI.method: 1) 采用基于矩量法（MoM）的电磁求解器作为核心仿真工具；2) 提出一种新颖的矩阵重构技术，通过预先将矩阵条目标记为"像素间"或"像素内"，从而加速每个像素化结构变体的仿真；3) 采用GPU加速来缓解多层结构带来的计算时间三次方增长问题；4) 集成随机多像素翻转搜索算法以提高收敛速度。
AI.result: 设计实现了一个双工器，其中一个通道的-3 dB带宽覆盖5.23-5.94 GHz，另一个通道覆盖6.17-7.15 GHz，并通过全波求解器验证了设计结果。
AI.conclusion: 该逆设计框架能够高效处理复杂多层多端口像素化表面的合成问题，所提出的矩阵重构、GPU加速及随机搜索算法相结合，显著提升了设计效率，并通过双工器设计实例证明了其可行性。

title: Generalized Holstein-Primakoff transformation with optimizable bosonic truncation
summary: Spin-wave theory provides a quasiparticle description of excitation spectra in quantum spin systems. In this theory, the spin operators are usually bosonized by the Holstein-Primakoff transformation or the Dyson-Maleev transformation. In practical calculations, the bosonized Hamiltonian has to be truncated, and thus the resulting excitation spectra depend on the choice of bosonic representation. Here, we introduce a generalized Holstein-Primakoff transformation that continuously interpolates between the conventional Holstein-Primakoff and Dyson-Maleev transformations through a single parameter. The formulation naturally extends to the SU(N) algebra and provides a flexible framework for optimizing bosonic truncations beyond harmonic order. As an application, we investigate the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic model on the square lattice. By combining the generalized Holstein-Primakoff transformation with continuous similarity transformations, we obtain excitation spectra in excellent agreement with tensor-network calculations. Our results demonstrate that optimizing the bosonic representation substantially reduces truncation errors and provides quantitatively reliable descriptions of both quasiparticle dispersions and multi-boson continua.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种广义Holstein-Primakoff变换，通过单一参数在传统HP变换与Dyson-Maleev变换之间连续插值，并将其推广至SU(N)代数。将该方法结合连续相似变换应用于正方晶格自旋-1双线性-双二次模型，获得的激发谱与张量网络计算结果高度一致，显著降低了玻色子截断误差。
AI.motivation: 自旋波理论中，霍斯坦-普里马科夫变换和戴森-马利夫变换等玻色化方案在截断后会导致激发谱依赖于玻色表示的选取，缺乏统一的优化框架来减小截断误差。
AI.method: 引入一个包含单一参数的广义Holstein-Primakoff变换，实现传统HP变换与DM变换之间的连续插值，并将该框架自然推广至SU(N)代数；结合连续相似变换用于计算自旋-1双线性-双二次模型的激发谱。
AI.result: 在正方晶格自旋-1双线性-双二次模型中，广义变换结合连续相似变换得到的激发谱与张量网络结果高度一致，表明优化玻色表示能大幅降低截断误差，可定量可靠地描述准粒子色散和多玻色子连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 优化玻色子表示是减小自旋波理论截断误差的有效途径，所提出的广义变换为超越谐振阶的截断优化提供了灵活框架。

title: Disorder induced time crystal in athermal random field Ising model with non-reciprocal interactions
summary: A two species random field Ising model with non-reciprocal interactions between the species is studied using the greedy Glauber dynamics. By solving the dynamics exactly on a complete graph, we obtain the phase diagram of the model as a function of the non-reciprocal interaction ($K$) and the variance ($σ$) of the quenched random field distribution. The model exhibits a rich phase diagram with the presence of a chaotic time-oscillatory phase for intermediate values of $K$ and $σ$. The chaotic phase has stable time oscillations along with the autocorrelation time that diverges with system size on a complete graph and also in three dimensions. We find that the random field disorder along with non-reciprocal interaction alone can produce a time crystal without an external driving. In two dimensions the autocorrelation time does not increase with the system size and the time crystal phase is absent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有非互惠相互作用的两物种随机场伊辛模型，通过贪婪格劳伯动力学在完全图上的精确求解，获得了非互惠相互作用强度(K)与淬火随机场方差(σ)的相图。模型表现出丰富的相图，在中等K和σ值下存在混沌时间振荡相，该相具有稳定的时间振荡且自发关联时间在完全图和三维体系中随系统尺寸发散。研究发现随机场无序与非互惠作用单独即可产生无需外部驱动的时间晶体，但二维体系中自发关联时间不随系统尺寸增长，时间晶体相缺失。
AI.motivation: 探索非互惠相互作用与随机场无序在无外部驱动条件下能否自发产生时间晶体，并系统理解非互惠相互作用系统中涌现的复杂动力学行为（如时间振荡与混沌相）及其维度依赖性。
AI.method: 采用贪婪格劳伯动力学（greedy Glauber dynamics），在完全图（complete graph）上精确求解两物种随机场伊辛模型的动力学方程，推导出以非互惠相互作用K和随机场方差σ为参数的系统相图；同时在三维和二维体系中进行数值模拟以检验时间晶体行为的维度依赖性。
AI.result: 模型展现出含混沌时间振荡相的丰富相图；混沌相的时间振荡稳定，且自发关联时间在完全图和三维体系中随系统尺寸发散；二维体系中自发关联时间不随系统尺寸增大，时间晶体相消失。表明随机场无序与非互惠相互作用单独即可产生无外部驱动的时间晶体。
AI.conclusion: 非互惠相互作用与随机场无序的组合是产生自发时间晶体的充分条件，但该现象具有维度依赖性：在完全图和三维中成立，在二维中不存在时间晶体相。

title: Cascading amplifiers can create exponentially large coherence
summary: A standard laser beam has photon degeneracy, or coherence, $\mathfrak{C}$, of at most $8μ^2$, where $μ$ is the number of photons in the laser itself. Even quantum-engineered lasers, if required to produce a beam with the standard statistical properties, have limited coherence, scaling as $μ^4$. Moreover, such lasers (still unrealised) require very unconventional gain and output-coupling mechanisms. Here, we propose a different path to increasing $\mathfrak{C}$: cascaded linear amplifiers, with conventional couplings. By dropping the requirement on the beam's properties, this approach can, in theory, achieve $\mathfrak{C}$ scaling exponentially in $μ$. Here $μ$ is the total source excitation number, across all the amplifiers. Two amplifiers suffice to surpass the standard $μ^2$ scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过级联线性放大器来提升光子简并度（相干性）的新路径，突破了标准激光器光子简并度最多为μ²、量子工程激光器最多为μ⁴的限制，理论上可实现光子简并度随总激发数μ呈指数增长。仅需两个级联放大器即可超越标准μ²标度。
AI.motivation: 标准激光束的光子简并度（相干性）受限于μ²（μ为激光器内光子数），而量子工程激光器即使具有标准统计特性，也只能将标度提升至μ⁴，且需要极其特殊的增益和输出耦合机制（尚未实现）。因此，需要探索一种更可行且能显著提升相干性的新路径。
AI.method: 采用级联线性放大器方案，放弃对光束标准统计性质的严格要求，使用常规耦合机构。通过级联多个线性放大器，每个级都可对相干性进行增强，从而在理论上获得光子简并度随总源激发数μ（所有放大器之和）呈指数增长的标度行为。仅需两级放大器即可超越标准激光器的μ²标度。
AI.result: 理论上，级联线性放大器方案可使光子简并度随总激发数μ呈指数增长（~exp(μ)），远超标准激光器的μ²和量子工程激光器的μ⁴标度。仅两级级联放大器就足以超越标准激光器的μ²上限。
AI.conclusion: 通过级联线性放大器并放松对光束统计性质的要求，可以在使用常规耦合机制的前提下，实现远超现有激光方案的光子简并度指数级增长，为高相干光源提供了新的理论途径。

title: Spindrift: Learning quantum degeneracy from thermal purity in restricted path integral Monte Carlo
summary:
Restricted path integral Monte Carlo (RPIMC) sidesteps the fluctuating Fermion sign problem by confining paths within nodal pockets of a trial density matrix, thereby recovering polynomial scaling. However, this nodal surface must be provided from elsewhere; unless it is exact, it introduces a fixed-node energy error.
  Here we introduce \textsc{Spindrift}, a Variational Density Matrix approach that learns the many-body Fermionic density matrix from a regularised Bloch residual, evaluated on samples drawn by a restricted Worm algorithm. Motivated by the observation of the `purity' of quantum mechanics at high temperature (where kinetic energy dominates), we train the density matrix along a temperature (imaginary time) curriculum, learning increasingly large \emph{corrections} to the initial free-particle reference. We parametrise our model with a permutation-equivariant continuous normalising flow to generate quasi-particle backflow trajectories, modulated by a symmetric Jastrow factor. This architecture guarantees exact Fermionic antisymmetry and spatial symmetry throughout training.
  Simulating $N=3$ interacting Fermions in a two-dimensional harmonic trap, we demonstrate stable curriculum training. The learnt velocity field smoothly deforms the nodal structure away from the free-particle reference. Open-Worm G-sector trapping provides a natural diagnostic for nodal accuracy.
  Although the current lack of a nodal action in our estimator precludes absolute benchmarking, \textsc{Spindrift} lowers the restricted thermodynamic energy relative to the free-particle reference at each temperature, establishing a stable, physics-informed framework for finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo where the nodal structure is learnt self-consistently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spindrift，一种变分密度矩阵方法，通过受限Worm算法采样的正则化Bloch残差来学习多体费米子密度矩阵。利用温度（虚时）课程学习，从自由粒子参考出发逐步学习修正项，采用置换等变连续归一化流生成准粒子背流轨迹并用对称Jastrow因子调制，从而保证费米反对称性和空间对称性。在二维谐振子阱中N=3相互作用费米子模拟中验证了稳定的课程训练和节点结构的平滑变形。
AI.motivation: 受限路径积分蒙特卡洛（RPIMC）通过将路径限制在试密度矩阵的节点口袋内来规避费米子符号问题，但节点面必须由外部提供，除非精确否则会引入固定节点能量误差。现有方法缺乏自洽学习节点结构的机制，因此需要一种能够从数据中自学习费米子密度矩阵（尤其是节点结构）的框架。
AI.method: Spindrift采用变分密度矩阵方法：(1) 从正则化的Bloch残差出发，在受限Worm算法采样的样本上评估损失；(2) 沿温度（虚时）课程训练，逐步学习对初始自由粒子参考的修正；(3) 使用置换等变连续归一化流生成准粒子背流轨迹，并加入对称Jastrow因子调制；(4) 架构保证严格的费米反对称性和空间对称性，无需额外约束。
AI.result: 在二维谐振子阱中模拟N=3相互作用费米子，实现了稳定的课程训练。学习到的速度场平滑地将节点结构从自由粒子参考变形。Open-Worm G-sector trapping提供了节点精度的自然诊断指标。Spindrift在每个温度下均降低了相对自由粒子参考的受限热力学能量。
AI.conclusion: Spindrift建立了一个稳定、物理驱动的有限温度量子蒙特卡洛框架，其中节点结构是自洽学习的而非外部提供的。虽然目前缺少节点作用量导致无法进行绝对基准测试，但该方法已证明可以有效降低受限热力学能量，为未来消除固定节点误差提供了可行路径。

title: Structured Neural Chaos: An Adaptive Surrogate Modeling Framework for Functional Uncertainty Quantification and Global Sensitivity Analysis
summary: Variance-based global sensitivity analysis (GSA) plays a key role in uncertainty quantification by identifying the contributions of uncertain inputs to the variability of the model response. The repeated model evaluations required for these tasks are often prohibitively expensive; surrogate models provide an efficient alternative by constructing inexpensive approximations of the underlying system response. Constructing surrogate models that combine scalability and interpretability for systems with high-dimensional stochastic inputs and functional responses remains challenging, particularly when sensitivity estimates are required across spatial or temporal domains. Polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) provides an effective framework for uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis due to its orthogonal structure and direct relationship with variance-based sensitivity measures. However, PCE suffers from the curse of dimensionality, whose computational burden is amplified for problems with functional responses. In this work, we introduce the Structured Neural Chaos (sNC) expansion as a surrogate modeling framework for variance-based GSA, inspired by the interpretability and orthogonal structure of PCE. The proposed framework retains the interpretability of structured decompositions while leveraging the expressive power of neural networks. The sNC expansion mirrors a truncated functional ANOVA decomposition, where each interaction component admits a separable low-rank approximation whose basis functions and coefficients are parameterized by neural networks. The expansion is constructed sequentially, adaptively identifying the dominant modes within each ANOVA subspace and determining the effective complexity of the representation. The resulting structure enables the extraction of statistical and sensitivity quantities directly from the coefficients of the sNC expansion at negligible cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构神经混沌（sNC）展开作为一种替代模型框架，用于基于方差的全灵敏度分析。该框架结合了多项式混沌展开的正交可解释性与神经网络的表达力，通过模拟截断的函数ANOVA分解，对每个交互分量采用可分离的低秩近似，并利用神经网络参数化基函数和系数。sNC展开顺序构建，自适应识别各ANOVA子空间内的主导模态，从而可直接从展开系数中以极低成本提取统计量和灵敏度指标。
AI.motivation: 基于方差的全局灵敏度分析需要大量模型评估，计算代价高昂；传统替代模型（如PCE）虽然具有正交结构和可解释性，但受维数灾难困扰，尤其对于具有函数响应的系统，计算负担被进一步放大。需要一种既能扩展至高维随机输入和函数响应，又保持可解释性的替代建模框架。
AI.method: 提出Structured Neural Chaos (sNC)展开：该框架模仿截断的函数ANOVA分解，每个交互分量可由可分离低秩近似表示，基函数和系数均由神经网络参数化；展开按顺序自适应构建，在每个ANOVA子空间内识别主导模态并确定表示的有效复杂度。
AI.result: sNC展开的结构使得统计量和灵敏度量可以直接从展开系数中以可忽略的计算成本提取，在保持PCE式可解释性的同时，利用神经网络的表达能力克服维数灾难，适用于高维随机输入和函数响应的灵敏度分析。
AI.conclusion: sNC展开为高维随机输入和函数响应的全局灵敏度分析提供了一个兼具可扩展性和可解释性的替代建模框架，弥合了多项式混沌展开与神经网络表达力之间的差距。

title: Quantum Optimal Control at Intermediate Times: Controlling Revivals in Spin Chains
summary: Standard Quantum Optimal Control (QOC) protocols typically maximize a physical objective just at a final target time. However, tracking or measuring the quantum state during the time evolution requires the control at intermediate stages of their evolution. In this work, we extend QOC to accommodate the simultaneous optimization of observables at arbitrary intermediate times. Using a variational approach, we show that intermediate observations induce discontinuities in the costate trajectory, which can be handled with a Krotov algorithm leading to monotonic optimization and convergent results in the limit of zero temporal measurement windows. We apply this multi-time formulation to a Heisenberg XXX spin chain to control the propagation, including field-free revivals, of a Dicke state excitation. Our results demonstrate that simultaneous optimization of the same observable reshapes the driving field to balance intermediate targets with final populations. Finally, we show how this framework enables dynamic tracking of spin excitations and the active manipulation of post-pulse quantum state revivals.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了标准量子最优控制（QOC），使其能够在任意中间时间同时优化可观测量。通过变分方法发现中间观测会在协态轨迹中引入不连续性，并采用Krotov算法处理，在零时间测量窗口极限下实现单调优化和收敛结果。作者将该多时间框架应用于Heisenberg XXX自旋链，控制Dicke态激发的传播（包括无场回波），证明同一可观测量的同时优化会重塑驱动场以平衡中间目标与最终布居，并实现自旋激发的动态跟踪和脉冲后量子态回波的人工操控。
AI.motivation: 标准量子最优控制协议仅在最终目标时间最大化物理目标函数，但实际应用中需要在时间演化过程中跟踪或测量量子态，即需要在演化中间阶段进行控制。现有QOC框架无法同时优化多个中间时刻的可观测量，因此需要扩展该框架来满足这一需求。
AI.method: 采用变分方法扩展QOC框架，通过在多中间时间点同时优化可观测量来构建新的目标泛函；利用变分分析证明中间观测会在协态（costate）轨迹中引入不连续性；基于Krotov算法处理这些不连续性，实现单调优化，并在零时间测量窗口极限下获得收敛结果。
AI.result: 在Heisenberg XXX自旋链上应用该多时间QOC框架，成功控制Dicke态激发的传播和无场回波现象。结果表明，同一可观测量的同时优化会重塑驱动场形状，以平衡中间目标与最终布居之间的关系；该框架还能实现自旋激发的动态跟踪以及脉冲后量子态回波的人工操控。
AI.conclusion: 该多时间QOC框架为量子控制提供了新的能力，使研究者能够在演化的中间时刻同时优化多个目标，扩展了最优控制理论的应用范围，为量子态的动态跟踪和量子信息处理中的精确操控开辟了新途径。

title: Critical Phases of the extended isotropic $XY$ chain with four-spin interaction
summary:
Using the Jordan-Wigner transformation we calculate exactly the ground state and low-temperature thermodynamic properties of the spin $S=1/2$ isotropic $XX$ chain with four spin interaction. In terms of the equivalent spinless fermion (SF) representation the system is viewed as a lattice fermion gas with nearest-neighbor ($J$) and next-next-next-neighbor ($J^{\ast}/4$) hopping. It is shown that with the increase of four spin coupling, at $J^{\ast}_{c} = 4J/3$ the system experiences the Lifshitz type topological phase transition characterized by the tripling of Fermi points. The quantum phase transition (QPT) point marks transition from a gapless spin-liquid phase of standard $XX$ chain into again a gapless spin-liquid phase with different character of power-low decay of spin correlations. At the transition point the free fermion dispersion relation shows flattering at Fermi points, what determines singular character of density of states $ρ(ω)\sim (ω/J)^{-2/3}$ and as a consequence unconventional temperature dependence of heat capacity of the system $C\sim (T/J^{\ast})^{1/3}$, and singular magnetic susceptibility of the system $χ(H)\sim (H/J^{\ast})^{-2/3}$.
  In the case of alternating magnetic field the system is characterized by the rich ground state phase diagram which contains fully polarized (ferromagnetic), gapped antiferromagnetic (AFM) and spin liquid phases. At the transition point from the gapped AFM phase into the gapless polarized spin liquid phase the system shows rapid increase of magnetization $m\sim(H-H_c)^{1/6}$ and magnetic susceptibility a singular behavior as $χ(H)\sim (H-H_c)^{-5/6}$.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Jordan-Wigner变换精确求解了具有四自旋相互作用的S=1/2各向同性XX链的基态和低温热力学性质。发现当四自旋耦合达到临界值J*_c = 4J/3时，系统发生Lifshitz型拓扑相变，费米点数目三倍化。在相变点，自由费米子色散关系在费米点处变平，导致密度态呈现奇异标度行为ρ(ω)~(ω/J)^{-2/3}，进而产生非常规的低温比热C~(T/J*)^{1/3}和奇异磁化率χ(H)~(H/J*)^{-2/3}。在交错磁场情形下，系统呈现包含完全极化、有隙反铁磁和自旋液体相的丰富基态相图。
AI.motivation: 研究多自旋相互作用对量子自旋链性质的影响，特别是四自旋相互作用如何改变XX链的相图和临界行为。这是理解超越标准最近邻相互作用模型的丰富量子多体物理的重要一步。
AI.method: 采用Jordan-Wigner变换将自旋问题精确映射为等效的无自旋费米子（SF）气体模型，其中系统表现为带有最近邻（J）和次次次近邻（J*/4）跳跃项的一维晶格费米子气。通过对自由费米子模型进行精确对角化求解其基态、色散关系、密度态以及热力学量。
AI.result: （1）在J*_c = 4J/3处发生Lifshitz型拓扑相变，费米点数三倍化，对应从标准XX链的无隙自旋液体相到另一种不同幂律衰减特性的无隙自旋液体相的量子相变。（2）相变点处费米子色散关系变平，产生奇异的密度态ρ(ω)~(ω/J)^{-2/3}，从而比热C~(T/J*)^{1/3}、磁化率χ(H)~(H/J*)^{-2/3}的非常规温度/场依赖。（3）在交错磁场下，系统基态相图包含完全极化铁磁相、有隙反铁磁相和自旋液体相；在从有隙反铁磁相到无隙极化自旋液体相的转变点，磁化强度快速增大m~(H-Hc)^{1/6}，磁化率奇异地发散χ(H)~(H-Hc)^{-5/6}。
AI.conclusion: 四自旋相互作用可以实质性地改变XX自旋链的量子临界行为，诱导Lifshitz型拓扑相变和丰富的相图结构（在交错磁场下包含极化、反铁磁和自旋液体相）。这些奇异临界指数的发现为理解多自旋相互作用系统的量子相变和非常规标度行为提供了重要的理论框架。

title: Exact Results for the Symmetric Dyson Exclusion Process
summary: The symmetric Dyson exclusion process (SDEP) is an exclusion process on the lattice with a long-range logarithmic Coulomb-type interaction. It appears in several equivalent forms: as symmetric random walkers conditioned, in the Doob-transform sense, not to collide; as the maximal-activity limit of a conditioned SSEP; and as a ground-state transform of the spin- 1/2 XX chain. In this work, we exploit this latter representation to obtain exact evolution formulas from deterministic initial configurations. The resulting determinantal kernel is expressed through a finite interpolation expression in terms of Lagrange polynomials, leading to explicit density evolution in finite and infinite lattices. For the melting of a densely packed block, we show that the full hierarchy of density moments is governed by a finite-dimensional polynomial algebra, and we identify Catalan numbers in the leading time coefficients. We also derive the Euler-scale density profile and the arctic curve separating frozen and liquid regions, and show that they coincide with conjectured hydrodynamic results obtained in a previous work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对称Dyson排斥过程（SDEP），利用其与自旋1/2 XX链的基态变换等价表示，从确定性初始构型出发得到精确演化公式，推导出密度演化、稠密区块的熔化动力学（关联到Catalan数）、Euler尺度密度轮廓及分隔冻结与液态区域的arctic曲线。
AI.motivation: SDEP是一个具有长程对数Coulomb型相互作用的排斥过程，具有多种等价表示形式，但其精确演化性质此前尚未被充分理解，尤其是从确定性初始构型出发的演化行为。本文旨在利用其与XX链的联系获得精确可解的结果。
AI.method: 利用SDEP作为自旋1/2 XX链基态变换的表示，通过有限插值表达式（Lagrange多项式）构造行列式核（determinantal kernel），从而获得确定性初始构型的精确演化公式。对稠密区块熔化问题，构建密度矩完整层次的有限维多项式代数，并推导Euler尺度密度轮廓与arctic曲线。
AI.result: 得到了有限格和无限格上显式的密度演化公式；在稠密区块熔化中，密度矩的完整层次由一个有限维多项式代数控制，领先时间系数中识别出Catalan数；Euler尺度密度轮廓和arctic曲线与先前工作中猜想的水动力结果相一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过XX链基态变换表示，SDEP从确定性初始条件出发的精确演化可以被完全刻画，且其宏观极限下的水动力行为与previously猜想的结果吻合，验证了该方法作为精确求解SDEP动力学工具的有效性。

title: Detection-resolution limits of large-momentum-transfer atom gravimetry
summary: Large momentum transfer (LMT) enhances the gravitational phase of a light-pulse atom interferometer by a factor $n$, while mirrorless operation with momentum-resolved detection can quadruple the phase-carrying quantum Fisher information. These gains compete in practice because the momentum-space fringe period scales as $1/n$, making the fringe signal increasingly vulnerable to finite detector resolution. We analyze this trade-off in a solvable model with instantaneous lossless $n$-photon pulses, a Gaussian source, and Gaussian detection blur, allowing continuous interpolation between Kasevich--Chu and mirrorless geometries. Closed-form expressions for the blurred output distributions and classical Fisher information are obtained, with a fringe-phase averaging approximation whose error is exponentially suppressed and agrees with numerical simulations at the $10^{-8}$ level. We find that mirrorless operation surpasses a conventional interferometer with the same momentum transfer only when $σ_p < 0.91\,m/(n k_0 T)$. Fringe-based readout exhibits an optimal momentum transfer $n^* \simeq 0.93\,m/(σ_p k_0 T)$ and a resolution-limited sensitivity floor $Δg \simeq 4.4\,σ_p/(mT\sqrt{N})$, independent of photon momentum. When this criterion is not satisfied, partial mirror asymmetry can recover part of the enhancement, whereas population-based readout remains insensitive to detector blur and ultimately favors the conventional sequence at sufficiently large $n$. Estimates for $^{87}$Rb sensors show that the mirrorless advantage is primarily restricted to short-baseline instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大动量转移(LMT)光脉冲原子干涉仪中，无镜操作与动量分辨探测相比传统Kasevich-Chu几何的优势与权衡。通过可解模型得到闭环解析表达式，发现无镜操作超越传统干涉仪的条件为σ_p < 0.91m/(n k_0 T)，并给出了最优动量转移和分辨率限制灵敏度下限。
AI.motivation: 大动量转移增强引力相位但导致动量空间条纹周期按1/n缩小，使信号对探测器分辨率敏感；而无镜操作可将相位携带的量子Fisher信息提高四倍。这两种增益在实践中相互竞争，需要定量分析权衡关系。
AI.method: 建立可解模型：瞬时无损耗n光子脉冲、高斯源和高斯探测模糊，允许在Kasevich-Chu与无镜几何之间连续插值。推导模糊输出分布和经典Fisher信息的闭环表达式，采用条纹相位平均近似（误差指数抑制），并用数值模拟验证到10^-8精度。
AI.result: 发现无镜操作超越同动量转移的传统干涉仪仅当σ_p < 0.91m/(n k_0 T)。条纹读出存在最优动量转移n* ≈ 0.93m/(σ_p k_0 T)，灵敏度下限Δg ≈ 4.4σ_p/(mT√N)与光子动量无关。不满足条件时，部分镜子不对称可恢复部分增益；基于布居数的读出不受探测器模糊影响，在足够大n时偏好传统序列。对^87Rb传感器的估算表明无镜优势主要限于短基线仪器。
AI.conclusion: 无镜操作的量子增强优势受探测器分辨率严重制约，其适用性主要限于短基线原子干涉仪；对于长基线或大动量转移场景，传统Kasevich-Chu几何仍是更优选择。

title: Persistent Convolution: A Topological Framework for AI Alignment Testing and Semantic Space Characterization
summary: Modern opaque AI models prize performance over interpretability, which makes testing difficult. However, formal statistical tests conducted on a model's embedding space can provide robust characterizations of semantic structure, concept separation, and knowledge graph alignment. Model developers would benefit from a model comparison technique that leverages human-curated knowledge structures to test alignment. The scale of the input space for even relatively simple tasks motivates the need for alignment checks that augment standard outcome reasoning. This work develops and demonstrates a topology-based multi-modal alignment test to make deployment, selection, and comparison of opaque models more interpretable. These methods also offer an intuitive connection to possibility theory and a unified decision theoretic framework from data to deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑的多模态对齐测试方法，通过在模型嵌入空间上进行形式化统计检验，来表征语义结构、概念分离和知识图谱对齐，从而增强不透明AI模型的可解释性和可测试性。
AI.motivation: 现代不透明AI模型追求性能而牺牲可解释性，导致测试困难。模型开发者需要一种利用人工策划的知识结构来测试模型对齐的比较技术，以增强部署、选择和比较的透明度。
AI.method: 开发并展示了一种基于拓扑的多模态对齐测试方法，在模型的嵌入空间上执行形式化统计检验，以评估语义结构、概念分离和知识图谱对齐。该方法与可能性理论（possibility theory）建立直观联系，并统一了从数据到部署的决策理论框架。
AI.result: 该方法为不透明模型的部署、选择和比较提供了更具可解释性的手段，通过拓扑对齐测试实现了对模型语义结构的稳健刻画。
AI.conclusion: 基于拓扑的多模态对齐测试能够为不透明AI模型提供可解释的对齐检验，将人工知识结构整合进模型比较流程，并统一了从数据处理到模型部署的决策框架。

title: Ultrafast Nonthermal Lattice Destabilization and Suppression of Polar Optical Scattering in Electronically Excited $α$-SiO$_2$ from First-Principles and Deep Neural Network Potential Modeling
comment: 49 pages, 12 figures, and 4 tables, including Supplemental Material
summary: We present a multiscale first-principles-to-machine-learning approach to investigate ultrafast lattice dynamics in electronically excited $α$-SiO$_2$. Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) based on electronic-temperature-dependent density functional theory (DFT) are used to train electronic-temperature-dependent deep neural network potentials (DNNPs). The use of DNNPs enables atomistic modeling at near-DFT accuracy of large $α$-SiO$_2$ cells with thousands of atoms. In particular, DNNPs allowed us to obtain accurate phonon band structures and molecular dynamics (MD) of $α$-SiO$_2$ excited by a sudden increase in electronic temperature. With increasing electronic temperature, $T_e$, pronounced lattice destabilization of $α$-SiO$_2$ is found, as evidenced by violations of elastic stability criteria, substantial volumetric expansion, a sharp reduction of the bulk modulus, and progressive weakening of Si-O bonding due to antibonding-state occupation. From the electronic and phonon band structures, we estimated the Frohlich coupling constant, which decreases as $T_e$ increases, suggesting a crossover to a nonpolar phase of $α$-SiO$_2$ at elevated electronic temperature. This is corroborated by the Bader charge analysis. We also suggest that polar optical phonon scattering should be strongly suppressed at $T_e > 2$ eV. From large-cell DNNP-MD simulations, we show that a well-defined thermal equilibrium, as defined by the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, is not achieved over the first few hundred femtoseconds. This behavior explains the non-monotonic equilibration of the kinetic temperature after a sudden rise of $T_e$. After $T_e$ is raised to 2.6 eV, Si and O atoms first equilibrate separately at two different temperatures, suggesting an atomic fluid phase, in agreement with recent experimental and theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从第一性原理到机器学习的多尺度方法，研究电子激发态α-SiO₂的超快晶格动力学。利用电子温度依赖的DFT训练深度神经网络势（DNNPs），实现数千原子级大体系的近DFT精度模拟，揭示了电子温度升高导致晶格失稳、体积膨胀、体模量骤降以及向非极性相转变的现象。
AI.motivation: 电子激发态（通过超快激光诱导电子温度骤升）下α-SiO₂的超快结构演化涉及大尺度、长时间尺度的原子运动，传统AIMD计算成本过高，难以模拟数千原子的大体系，亟需兼具DFT精度和机器学习效率的方法来研究其非平衡晶格动力学。
AI.method: 采用多尺度方法论：(1) 基于电子温度依赖的DFT进行AIMD模拟获取训练数据；(2) 训练电子温度依赖的深度神经网络势（DNNPs）；(3) 利用DNNPs进行大单元（数千原子）的声子带结构计算和分子动力学模拟；(4) 结合电子/声子带结构估算Frohlich耦合常数，并通过Bader电荷分析佐证化学键变化。
AI.result: 发现电子温度升高时α-SiO₂发生显著的晶格失稳（弹性稳定性准则被违反）、体积膨胀、体模量骤降、Si-O键因反键态占据而减弱；Frohlich耦合常数随T_e增加而降低，表明向非极性相交叉；Bader电荷分析予以佐证；大体系DNNP-MD显示数百飞秒内体系未达到麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼热平衡，且当T_e升至2.6 eV时Si与O原子先分别达到不同温度，呈现原子流体相。
AI.conclusion: 电子温度依赖的DNNPs有效拓展了AIMD的模拟尺度，揭示了电子激发态α-SiO₂在飞秒时间尺度上经历的非平衡、非单调的晶格动力学过程，包括晶格失稳、极性到非极性的相变倾向以及原子流体相的出现，与近期实验和理论结果一致。

title: Successive Electronic Topological Transitions in the Antiferromagnet UPd$_2$Al$_3$
summary: We report successive anomalies at low temperature in the magnetic field dependence of the thermoelectric signal in the heavy fermion compound UPd$_{2}$Al$_{3}$ inside the antiferromagnetic state up to the metamagnetic transition at $H_\text{M} =18$~T. Based on renormalisation perturbation theory and the partitioning of the $f$ orbitals into localized and delocalized parts, our analysis attributes these anomalies to complex topological changes of the Fermi surface driven by Zeeman effect. The observation of a sudden change of sign both in the thermoelectric power and in the Hall coefficient at $H_\text{M}$ in addition to the appearance of large quantum oscillations in the thermoelectric power above $H_\text{M}$ indicate a strong Fermi surface reconstruction at the metamagnetic transition due to the unfolding of the electronic bands.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了重费米子化合物UPd₂Al₃在反铁磁态至亚磁转变（H_M=18 T）期间，热电信号随磁场出现的连续低温异常。通过重整化微扰理论和f轨道局域化/去局域化划分，将异常归因于塞曼效应驱动的费米面复杂拓扑变化。在H_M处热电功率和霍尔系数符号突变，以及H_M之上热电功率出现大幅量子振荡，表明亚磁转变伴随电子能带展开导致的强烈费米面重构。
AI.motivation: 理解重费米子化合物在中磁场下的电子结构演变，特别是亚磁转变附近的费米面重构机制，为揭示强关联电子体系中的拓扑相变提供实验与理论依据。
AI.method: 结合低温磁场依赖的热电信号测量（包括热电功率和霍尔系数），并采用基于重整化微扰理论及f轨道局域化/去局域化分区的理论分析方法进行阐述。
AI.result: 在反铁磁态至18 T亚磁转变区间观察到热电信号的连续异常；在H_M处热电功率与霍尔系数均出现符号突变；H_M以上热电功率呈现大幅量子振荡，指示费米面强烈重构。
AI.conclusion: 亚磁转变对应电子能带展开引发的费米面拓扑重构，塞曼效应驱动的费米面拓扑变化是低温磁场依赖热电异常的根本原因。

title: Charge discreteness and the energy efficiency of information erasure in dynamic random-access memory cells
summary: A dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) cell stores information as an integer number of electrons on a capacitor, and whether this discreteness is thermodynamically relevant depends on the competition between the charging energy and thermal fluctuations. This competition is quantified by the ratio $κ$ of the single-electron charging energy to the thermal energy, and here we investigate how $κ$ affects the energy efficiency of information erasure in a DRAM cell. Using a stochastic-thermodynamic model of a DRAM cell, we show that the nonquasistatic heat released during the discharge step is suppressed as $κ$ increases, whereas the quasistatic heat of the charge step approaches the Landauer cost. As a result, the energy efficiency increases monotonically with $κ$ and approaches the Landauer limit where the effect of charge discreteness is maximal and the cell is effectively reduced to two charge states. The parameter $κ$ thus connects two thermodynamic regimes: a multilevel single-well memory, whose nonequilibrium initial state prevents quasistatic erasure, and an effective two-level memory that can attain the Landauer limit. These results identify $κ$ as the parameter that controls the fundamental efficiency ceiling of transistor--capacitor memory circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机热力学模型研究DRAM单元中电荷离散性参数κ对信息擦除能量效率的影响，发现能量效率随κ单调增加并趋近Landauer极限。
AI.motivation: DRAM单元以电容上的整数个电子存储信息，电荷离散性是否在热力学上相关取决于充电能量与热涨落的竞争（参数κ）。理解κ如何影响信息擦除的能量效率，对于揭示晶体管-电容存储电路的基本效率上限至关重要。
AI.method: 采用DRAM单元的随机热力学模型，分析参数κ（单电子充电能与热能之比）对放电和充电两阶段的非准静态热与准静态热的影响，并比较不同电荷态数目下的热力学行为。
AI.result: 放电阶段的非准静态热随κ增大而受到抑制，而充电阶段的准静态热趋近于Landauer成本。能量效率随κ单调增加，并在κ足够大时趋近Landauer极限，此时电荷离散性效应最大化，单元被有效简化为两个电荷态。
AI.conclusion: 参数κ将两种热力学机制联系起来：多能级单阱存储器（非平衡初始态阻止准静态擦除）与可达到Landauer极限的有效两能级存储器。κ由此成为控制晶体管-电容存储电路基本效率上限的关键参数。

title: Gaussian-augmented bosonic matrix-product states: theory and applications
summary: We propose and analyze the structure of a family of bosonic quantum many-body states that have the following features: (i) they include all pure Gaussian states and finite-dimensional matrix-product states as subclasses; (ii) their expectation values can be efficiently computed, allowing them to be used, among other things, for variational calculations; (iii) they admit exact parent Hamiltonians expressed as simple functions of the bosonic creation and annihilation operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一族玻色子量子多体态的结构，该体系同时包含所有纯高斯态和有限维矩阵乘积态作为子类，且其期望值可高效计算并具有精确父哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 现有的量子多体态类别（如高斯态和矩阵乘积态）各自具有局限性：高斯态只能描述非相互作用或弱相互作用的玻色子系统，而矩阵乘积态主要适用于有限维系统且难以直接处理连续的玻色子自由度。因此需要一种更一般的态族，能够统一这两类态的优势，为变分计算和强关联玻色子系统的研究提供更强大的工具。
AI.method: 提出一个全新的玻色子量子多体态族，其核心结构特性包括：(i) 该态族作为一个统一框架，将纯高斯态和有限维矩阵乘积态都作为其子类纳入其中；(ii) 设计上保证期望值的计算效率，使其适用于变分计算等实际任务；(iii) 为该态族构造了以玻色子产生和湮灭算符的简单函数形式表达的精确父哈密顿量，从而在物理上保证这些态可以作为某些哈密顿量的基态。
AI.result: 成功构造并分析了这一新的玻色子多体态族，证明了其包含高斯态和矩阵乘积态作为特例，并验证了期望值计算的效率及精确父哈密顿量的存在性。
AI.conclusion: 该态族为玻色子量子多体系统提供了一个统一的变分框架，兼具高斯态的可处理性和矩阵乘积态的表达能力，为强关联玻色子系统的数值模拟与解析分析开辟了新的途径。

title: Simple-regret rates and minimax optimality of fixed-prior expected improvement in Matérn and squared-exponential RKHSs
summary:
We study the expected improvement (EI) policy for minimizing a deterministic objective function $f$ on a nonempty compact set $\mathcal X \subset\mathbb R^d$. We assume that $f$ belongs to the RKHS $\mathcal H_k$ of a continuous positive-semidefinite kernel $k$ on $\mathcal X$. Function values are observed exactly, and EI is computed from a fixed zero-mean Gaussian-process model with covariance $σ^2k$. After an initial design, the policy queries a point whose EI is at least a fixed positive fraction of its maximum.
  We identify the normalized posterior standard deviation at a candidate point $x$ with the norm of the corresponding innovation in the canonical feature space, namely the component of $k(x,\cdot)$ orthogonal to the span of the preceding evaluation representers. Sequential separation radii bound the ranked innovation norms along arbitrary query sequences. We estimate these radii using Gram determinants and Kolmogorov widths for subspaces of different dimensions, then combine the estimates with a one-step regret inequality to obtain finite-budget bounds for simple regret.
  After $N$ post-initial queries, simple regret is $O(N^{-ν/d})$ for isotropic Matérn kernels of smoothness $ν>0$. For the isotropic squared-exponential kernel, simple regret is $O(\exp[-c_1\min\{N, N^{1/d}\log(eN)\}])$ for some $c_1>0$. With exact EI maximization, it is $O(\exp[-c_2N^{1/d} \log(eN)])$ for some $c_2>0$. For every fixed $B\geq0$, these bounds are uniform over the RKHS ball of radius $B$.
  If $\mathcal X$ has nonempty interior and $B>0$, then, among deterministic methods whose final recommendation may be any point of $\mathcal X$, the exact EI policy is minimax-rate optimal over the RKHS ball of radius $B$ for Matérn kernels and minimax-rate optimal up to constants in the exponent for squared-exponential kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在RKHS中最小化确定性目标函数的期望改进（EI）策略，给出了有限预算下的简单遗憾界，并证明了EI策略在Matérn核和平方指数核上的极小极大最优性。
AI.motivation: 期望改进（EI）是贝叶斯优化中最常用的获取函数之一，但其理论保证（特别是有限预算下的遗憾界）长期缺乏严格分析。作者希望填补这一空白，证明EI策略在RKHS框架下的收敛速率和最优性。
AI.method: 作者将归一化后验标准差与典型特征空间中的innovation范数相联系，利用序贯分离半径（sequential separation radii）来界定任意查询序列的排序innovation范数。通过Gram行列式和不同维度子空间的Kolmogorov宽度来估计这些半径，再结合一步遗憾不等式，得到有限预算下的简单遗憾界。
AI.result: 对于各向同性Matérn核（光滑度ν>0），N次查询后简单遗憾为O(N^{-ν/d})；对于各向同性平方指数核，简单遗憾为O(exp[-c1·min{N, N^{1/d}·log(eN)}])，精确EI最大化时为O(exp[-c2·N^{1/d}·log(eN)])。这些界对RKHS球半径B均匀一致。当X有非空内部且B>0时，精确EI策略在Matérn核上达到极小极大最优速率，在平方指数核上达到指数中常数级别的极小极大最优。
AI.conclusion: EI策略在精确观测和RKHS假设下享有可证明的收敛保证，且在Matérn核和平方指数核上分别达到或接近极小极大最优速率，为EI策略的理论地位提供了坚实支撑。

title: Extrapolating the emergence of Hamiltonian chaos with random-feature Hamiltonian neural networks
summary: Machine learning of Hamiltonian dynamics has driven growing interest in Hamiltonian neural networks (HNNs), which encode Hamilton's equations of motion into the learning architecture. Despite this progress, it remains unknown whether such networks can predict dynamical regimes absent from their training data, in particular the broad chaotic sea that emerges beyond the observed parameter interval. We address this question using a parameter-aware random-feature Hamiltonian neural network (RF-HNN). Trained using data from only a small number of control-parameter values at which invariant tori dominate, the RF-HNN predicts autonomous long-time dynamics at unseen parameter values where mixed phase space develops and chaotic regions expand, with no data from that regime used in training or model selection. The method is demonstrated across four two-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian families, including the Hénon-Heiles system. Using Poincaré-section geometry and finite-time Lyapunov exponents, we show that the RF-HNN reproduces the breakup of regular structures and the emergence and growth of chaotic regions, whereas conventionally trained HNNs with the same Hamiltonian structure remain too regular. These results show that what decides parameter extrapolation is not Hamiltonian structure alone but how the fitted Hamiltonian continues in the control parameter. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a learned Hamiltonian can qualitatively extrapolate from predominantly regular dynamics into a broad chaotic sea absent from training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数感知随机特征哈密顿神经网络（RF-HNN），仅用少量控制参数下不变环面占主导的训练数据，即可在未见过的参数值处预测混沌海的出现与增长，首次证明学习的哈密顿量能从规则动力学定性外推到训练数据中不存在的混沌区域。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿神经网络（HNN）虽能编码哈密顿运动方程，但此前未知其能否预测训练数据之外的动力学机制，尤其是参数区间外涌现的混沌海。作者希望回答：学习到的哈密顿量能否从规则动力学位势外推到混沌区域？
AI.method: 采用参数感知的随机特征哈密顿神经网络（RF-HNN），仅在少数控制参数值下（以不变环面为主导）进行训练，在四个二自由度哈密顿族上进行验证（含Hénon-Heiles系统），利用庞加莱截面几何和有限时间Lyapunov指数评估外推能力，并与传统HNN对比。
AI.result: RF-HNN在未见过的参数值下成功再现了规则结构的破裂、混沌区域的出现与增长；而具有相同哈密顿结构的传统HNN则过于规则，无法捕捉混沌动力学。决定参数外推能力的不是哈密顿结构本身，而是拟合哈密顿量在控制参数上的延续方式。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次证明学习的哈密顿量能从以规则为主的动力学定性外推到训练数据中完全不存在的广阔混沌海，为该类模型在混沌预测和参数泛化方面开辟了新方向。

title: Photoemission insights into lanthanide-based crystals
summary: The interplay of strongly localized 4$f$ electrons with itinerant spd-valence states gives rise to a wide range of correlated phenomena and properties that place lanthanide materials at the focus of considerable research efforts. Beyond the bulk, their surfaces are of particular interest, where the reduced coordination, a modified crystal electric field, broken inversion symmetry in combination with strong spin-orbit coupling, and the emergence of surface states and resonances considerably reshape 4$f$-driven electronic and magnetic properties. This, in turn, enables novel functionalities of particular relevance for low-dimensional systems and their applications. This review summarizes how advances in photoelectron spectroscopies, together with improved crystal growth, have enabled detailed insights into bulk and surface phenomena of lanthanide-based crystals. After a brief overview of key developments from the 1970s to the 1990s, we discuss recent progress, focusing on systematic studies by the authors and collaborators that form a coherent line of research. These include the unveiling of $k$-resolved $f-spd$ hybridization, the formation and evolution with temperature of $f$-derived Fermi surface in Kondo lattices, layer-dependent 4$f$ magnetic anisotropy, the emergence of ferromagnetically ordered surfaces in systems with non-magnetic bulk ground state. This coherent line of research addresses core questions in the physics of 4$f$ systems and opens opportunities for engineering novel lanthanide-based architectures, including heterostructures and supramolecular complexes with novel physical properties and functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了光电子能谱学与晶体生长技术进步如何推动对镧系材料体相与表面4f电子驱动现象的理解，涵盖k分辨的f-spd杂化、Kondo晶格中f导出的费米面、层依赖的4f磁各向异性以及非磁体相系统中铁磁表面的涌现，并展望了基于镧系的新型低维结构与功能材料工程。
AI.motivation: 镧系材料中强局域4f电子与巡游spd价态之间的相互作用产生了丰富的强关联现象，其表面因配位减少、晶场修饰、反演对称破缺与强自旋轨道耦合等效应进一步重塑了4f驱动的电子和磁性质，为低维系统和应用提供新功能。作者希望通过综述总结光电子能谱学技术进展如何揭示这些体相与表面现象。
AI.method: 综述方法：简要回顾1970至1990年代的关键发展后，聚焦于作者及其合作者开展的系统性研究，利用先进的光电子能谱技术（如k分辨的光电子能谱）结合改进的晶体生长方法，对镧系单晶的体相与表面电子结构和磁性进行系统表征。
AI.result: 该研究路线取得了一系列重要成果：揭示了k分辨的f-spd杂化；阐明了Kondo晶格中f导出费米面的形成及其随温度的演化；发现了层依赖的4f磁各向异性；以及在体相为磁基态的体系中观测到表面铁磁有序。
AI.conclusion: 这一连贯的研究方向解决了4f系统物理中的核心问题，并为工程设计新型镧系基架构（包括异质结构和超分子复合物）提供了新的机遇，有望实现具有新颖物理性质和功能特性的材料体系。

title: Scalar curvature density as a new invariant in thermodynamic geometry: metric dependence and critical exponents
summary: We compare two Ruppeiner metrics constructed under fixed volume and fixed particle number conditions ($g_{_V}$ and $g_{_V}$) by analyzing the scalar curvature $R$ and introducing the scalar curvature density $\mathcal{R} = \sqrt{|g|}\,R$ as a complementary geometric invariant. Three fluid models of increasing physical realism are considered: van der Waals, Lennard-Jones, and argon described by a multiparameter equation of state that correctly reproduces non-mean-field critical behavior consistent with the Ising universality class. We find that $R$ and $\mathcal{R}$ exhibit distinct critical scaling: $R \sim t^{-dν}$ is governed by the correlation length exponent, whereas $\mathcal{R} \sim t^{-(1+β)}$ scales solely with the order parameter exponent $β$, a result that follows analytically from hyperscaling and the Rushbrooke relation independently of the universality class. The $N$-metric consistently outperforms the $V$-metric in reconstructing the vapor-liquid coexistence curve away from criticality, and the four Widom lines defined by the minima of $R_{_V}$, $R_{_N}$, $\mathcal{R}_{_V}$, and $\mathcal{R}_{_N}$ display a characteristic fourfold structure reproduced across all three models. The loci where both representations yield identical geometric descriptions define two new objects: the Curvature Equality Curve (CEC, $R_{_V} = R_{_N}$) and the Curvature-Density Equality Curve (CDEC, $\mathcal{R}_{_V} = \mathcal{R}_{_N}$), with the CDEC enclosing a substantially larger region of the phase diagram in all cases. These results establish $\mathcal{R}$ as a meaningful complement to $R$ in thermodynamic geometry and highlight the nontrivial role of metric choice in the description of phase transitions and supercritical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了定体积与定粒子数两种Ruppeiner度量（g_V与g_N）在热力学几何中的表现，引入标量曲率密度R作为补充几何不变量，并在范德瓦尔斯、Lennard-Jones及氩（多参数状态方程）三种模型中检验其临界标度行为，发现R~t^{-dν}由关联长度指数控制，而R~t^{-(1+β)}仅由序参量指数β控制；N度量在重建汽液共存线方面优于V度量，并定义了曲率等值曲线（CEC）和曲率密度等值曲线（CDEC）两个新对象。
AI.motivation: 热力学几何中Ruppeiner度量的选择（定体积vs定粒子数）对几何不变量及其物理诠释有重要影响，但二者在临界标度行为、相图重建能力方面的系统比较尚缺乏。作者旨在通过引入新的几何不变量R来补充R，并探索度量选择对描述相变和超临界行为的非平凡作用。
AI.method: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：在固定体积和固定粒子数条件下分别构造两种Ruppeiner度量g_V和g_N，计算标量曲率R及新定义的标量曲率密度R=√|g|R；在三种流体模型（范德瓦尔斯、Lennard-Jones、多参数状态方程描述的氩）中分析临界标度、Widom线结构及曲率等值曲线。
AI.result: 发现R和R具有不同的临界标度：R~t^{-dν}由关联长度指数dν控制，而R~t^{-(1+β)}仅由序参量指数β决定，且该结果由超标度关系和Rushbrooke关系解析推导，与普适类无关。N度量在远离临界区重建汽液共存线方面始终优于V度量。四种Widom线（R_V、R_N、R_V、R_N的极小值定义）展现出特征性的四重结构，在三种模型中均复现。CEC和CDEC两种等值曲线中，CDEC包围的相图区域在所有情况下均显著更大。
AI.conclusion: 标量曲率密度R是R的有意义补充量，为热力学几何提供了更丰富的物理信息；度量选择（定体积vs定粒子数）在描述相变和超临界行为中扮演非平凡角色，N度量整体上优于V度量，且CDEC所界定的区域可作为几何描述一致的更广泛有效性范围。

title: High-rate qLDPC processors
comment: 13 pages main text + 73 pages appendix; 13 figures
summary: Despite significant progress on quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes, building qLDPC processors that are high-rate, high-throughput, hardware-friendly, and fast-to-decode remains a challenge. We introduce mitten codes, a family of qLDPC processor codes of encoding rate $20\%$ and check weight $9$, based on non-abelian groups. Their non-abelian structure evades distance bounds constraining abelian counterparts, allowing mitten codes to reach distance $18$ and beyond with just a few hundred data qubits. The logical operators of a mitten code are related by the group action, yielding a modular, low-overhead logical toolkit: full Clifford operations follow from bridging two reusable seed surgery gadgets or from a single fixed extractor. Furthermore, qLDPC processors based on mitten codes support high-rate surgery that executes many logical measurements in parallel, and parallel magic-state injection into all logical qubits at once. Under circuit-level noise, with our fast decoder, the $[\![300,60,14]\!]$ mitten code achieves, without extrapolation, a block logical error rate of ${\sim}10^{-11}$ per round at $0.1\%$ physical error rate (PER), while the $[\![ 975,195,\leq 24 ]\!]$ code reaches ${\sim}10^{-8}$ at $0.4\%$ PER. Decoding $15$ billion surgery experiments on the $[\![540,108,18]\!]$ code at $0.1\%$ PER, we observe only two logical failures, demonstrating a qLDPC processor capable of running ${\sim}10^{10}$ logical operations. Our decoder is compatible with sub-millisecond average latency per logical cycle, sufficient for real-time decoding on neutral atom hardware. Discovered by an end-to-end design pipeline built on sQetch, a distance estimator orders of magnitude faster than existing tools, and mapping efficiently onto near-term neutral atom and superconducting hardware, mitten codes open a practical path toward fault-tolerant quantum computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"mitten codes"——一类基于非阿贝尔群的qLDPC处理器码族，编码率20%、校验权重9，距离可达18以上（仅需几百个数据量子比特），并配套设计流水线、快速解码器和外科手术（surgery）逻辑工具包，在电路级噪声下实现极低逻辑错误率和亚毫秒解码延迟，可直接映射到中性原子和超导硬件。
AI.motivation: 尽管qLDPC码已有显著进展，但构建高编码率、高吞吐、硬件友好且可快速解码的qLDPC处理器仍具挑战性。阿贝尔群结构的qLDPC码受到距离界的约束，难以在少量量子比特下达到足够距离。
AI.method: 利用非阿贝尔群结构规避阿贝尔码的距离界限制；逻辑算符通过群作用相关联，形成模块化的逻辑工具包（两个可复用种子surgery gadget或单一固定extractor即可实现完整Clifford操作）；支持并行surgery测量和并行magic-state注入；配套端到端设计流水线，基于sQetch这一比现有工具快数个数量级的距离估计器。
AI.result: [300,60,14]码在0.1%物理错误率下达到约10^-11的块逻辑错误率（无需外推）；[975,195,≤24]码在0.4%错误率下达到约10^-8；在[540,108,18]码上解码150亿次surgery实验仅观察到2次逻辑失败，支持约10^10次逻辑操作；解码器平均延迟低于亚毫秒，满足中性原子硬件实时解码需求。
AI.conclusion: Mitten codes通过非阿贝尔群结构、高效解码器和完整的逻辑操作工具包，为容错量子计算开辟了实际可行的路径，可高效映射到近期中性原子和超导硬件平台。

title: The Greedy Advantage in Finite-Horizon Bandits
comment: 122 pages, 3 figures, submitted to Management Science and under peer review
summary: Organizations increasingly rely on sequential experimentation to improve decision-making. While the multi-armed bandit literature has developed algorithms with strong asymptotic regret guarantees, many practical applications operate over finite and externally imposed horizons. Motivated by the finite-horizon setting, we develop a class of regularized greedy algorithms for multi-armed Bernoulli bandits. We derive the first finite-horizon regret envelopes for regularized greedy bandits, showing that finite-horizon regret decomposes into transient exploration costs and a suboptimal convergence term that decays exponentially with the regularization strength. This characterization yields principled calibration rules for the regularization parameters and, as a limiting case, sharper regret guarantees for the classical greedy policy. Across extensive numerical experiments, calibrated regularized greedy policies consistently match or outperform state-of-the-art algorithms. These results suggest that regularized greedy policies can provide an effective approach for finite-horizon bandit problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有限时间范围的多臂伯努利老虎机问题，提出了一类正则化贪心算法，推导了首个有限时间范围的遗憾界上界，证明了遗憾可分解为瞬态探索成本和随正则化强度指数衰减的次优收敛项，并给出了正则化参数的校准规则和经典贪心策略的更优遗憾保证。
AI.motivation: 多臂老虎机文献中的算法大多关注渐近遗憾界，但实际应用中往往面临有限且外部强加的决策范围。现有算法在有限时间范围内的性能缺乏理论保证，需要针对有限时间范围设计的算法及其遗憾分析。
AI.method: 提出正则化贪心算法（regularized greedy algorithms）用于多臂伯努利老虎机。理论上推导了有限时间范围的遗憾上界（regret envelope），将遗憾分解为瞬态探索成本和指数衰减的次优收敛项；基于该表征推导了正则化参数的校准规则，并由此获得经典贪心策略在极限情况下的更优遗憾界。
AI.result: 推导出首个有限时间范围正则化贪心老虎机的遗憾上界；通过表征得到正则化参数的校准规则；广泛的数值实验表明校准后的正则化贪心策略一致地达到或超越现有最先进算法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 正则化贪心策略能够为有限时间范围的老虎机问题提供有效的解决方案，兼具理论保证和实际性能优势。

title: Frugal Bayesian Optimization: Scalable Surrogates for Data- and Resource-Limited Discovery
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely adopted for data-efficient optimization in scientific and engineering applications, yet its computational cost is rarely evaluated alongside optimization performance. Here we present a systematic, compute-aware study of BO that evaluates surrogate models along two axes: optimization quality and computational frugality. Across eight benchmark functions and nine real-world datasets spanning materials science, mechanics, robotics, chemistry, and machine learning, we benchmark four surrogate models: Gaussian Processes, Random Forests, NGBoost, and Bayesian Adaptive Spline Surfaces. We show that Gaussian Process-based BO consistently incurs the highest time and memory overhead without delivering superior optimization or sample efficiency. In contrast, scalable alternatives achieve equal or better performance at a fraction of the computational cost. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a surrogate-recommendation framework that predicts the most suitable BO surrogate from inexpensive dataset characteristics. Together, these results establish FruBO as a reproducible, compute-aware baseline for Bayesian Optimization and provide practical guidance for surrogate selection under limited computational and experimental budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算感知（compute-aware）的贝叶斯优化（BO）系统研究框架 FruBO，从优化质量和计算节俭性两个维度系统评估四种代理模型，发现高斯过程虽广泛使用但计算开销最高且并无性能优势，同时提出一个基于廉价数据集特征的代理模型推荐框架。
AI.motivation: 尽管贝叶斯优化在科学和工程中被广泛采用，但其计算成本很少与优化性能一起被评估。作者希望填补这一空白，提供系统的、计算感知的BO基准研究，并给出在计算和实验预算受限情况下的实用代理模型选择指导。
AI.method: 在8个基准函数和9个真实数据集（覆盖材料、力学、机器人、化学和机器学习）上，对四种代理模型（高斯过程、随机森林、NGBoost和贝叶斯自适应样条曲面）沿优化质量和计算节俭性两个维度进行系统基准测试；基于基准测试结果，进一步提出一个代理模型推荐框架，利用廉价的数据集特征预测最适合的代理模型。
AI.result: 高斯过程驱动的BO始终产生最高的时间和内存开销，但没有带来更优的优化性能或样本效率；可扩展的替代方案以一小部分计算成本即可实现相同或更优的性能；在此基础上建立的代理推荐框架能够有效预测最优代理模型。
AI.conclusion: FruBO作为可复现的、计算感知的贝叶斯优化基线，建立了更广泛的BO计算与性能基准，为计算和实验预算有限的实际应用提供了实用的代理模型选择指导。

title: Beyond Stoner-Wohlfarth: Machine-Learning Models and Symbolic Regression of Hard-Magnet Properties
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material (8 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables) included as an ancillary file
summary: Predicting the extrinsic properties from hysteresis loops of a magnetic grain, namely the coercive field, remanent magnetisation, and maximum energy product, from its intrinsic micromagnetic parameters is a central problem in permanent-magnet modelling. Established analytical models provide useful estimates but often neglect nonuniform magnetisation processes, whereas direct micromagnetic simulations are computationally expensive. In this work, we train machine-learning models on 12012 micromagnetic simulations of an idealised cubic grain, spanning broad ranges of the saturation magnetisation, exchange constant, and uniaxial anisotropy constant. Benchmarked against the analytical models on identical held-out data, the machine-learning models predict all three extrinsic properties with substantially lower errors. Symbolic regression recovers the Kronmüller form of the coercive field, with an effective demagnetising factor that depends on the material, and finds new closed-form expressions for the remanence and maximum energy product. Each law contains at most two fitted constants yet approaches the accuracy of the machine-learning models. We also investigate the inverse problem of recovering the intrinsic parameters from the three extrinsic properties. The saturation magnetisation and anisotropy constant are recovered accurately, whereas the exchange constant is not, because it influences the extrinsic properties only weakly. The trained models are released through the mammos-ai Python package, enabling thousands of candidate parameter sets to be screened in seconds rather than the hours or days required by direct micromagnetic simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用12012次微磁模拟数据训练机器学习模型，预测磁性晶粒的矫顽场、剩磁和最大磁能积三种外在磁性属性，较传统解析模型误差大幅降低。符号回归恢复了Kronmüller形式的矫顽场表达式，并发现剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式表达式。作者还研究了逆问题（从外在属性反推内在参数），发现饱和磁化强度和各向异性常数可准确恢复，但交换常数难以恢复。模型通过mammos-ai Python包发布。
AI.motivation: 从磁性晶粒的固有微磁参数（饱和磁化强度、交换常数、单轴各向异性常数）预测其外在磁滞回线属性（矫顽场、剩磁、最大磁能积）是永磁体建模的核心问题。已有的解析模型虽可提供估计，但常忽略非均匀磁化过程；而直接微磁模拟计算成本高昂，需要更高效且准确的方法。
AI.method: 在理想化立方晶粒上执行12012次微磁模拟，覆盖广泛的饱和磁化强度、交换常数和单轴各向异性常数范围。基于这些数据训练机器学习模型，与解析模型在相同保留数据集上对比；使用符号回归从数据中提取闭式物理规律；同时研究从外在属性反推内在参数的逆问题。
AI.result: 机器学习模型在预测三种外在属性时误差显著低于解析模型。符号回归恢复了Kronmüller形式的矫顽场公式（含依赖于材料的有效退磁因子），并发现新的剩磁和最大磁能积闭式表达式，每条物理定律最多含两个拟合常数却接近机器学习模型的精度。逆问题中，饱和磁化强度和各向异性常数可准确恢复，但交换常数因对外在属性影响较弱而无法准确恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该方法结合了机器学习的精度与解析表达式的可解释性，通过符号回归获得了具有物理意义且高精度的闭式表达式，并通过mammos-ai Python包实现快速参数筛选（秒级对比传统模拟的时/天级），为永磁体材料设计提供了高效工具。

title: Entropy production of active matter systems as indicator for computing performance
summary: Physical systems can process information through their natural dynamics, offering alternatives to conventional digital computing. Reservoir computing offers a basic framework by using a nonlinear substrate to map inputs into rich dynamical states read out by a simple linear layer. Active matter substrates are striking examples; they continuously consume energy and produce entropy. Theoretically, entropy production (EP) can describe the irreversibility and distance from equilibrium. But it remains unclear whether it can track computational capabilities. We address this conceptual gap by analyzing a driven swarm reservoir model. The system EP is computed from phase-space contraction and the bath EP from heat flow, separately, and put in direct association to prediction performance on a Lorenz-63 task. Via force parameter scans, we show that dynamical regimes with the strongest response to a driver as well as dissipation coincide with peak performance. Therein, the dynamical discrepancy between innate (minimal dissipation) and driven transferred heat (maximal dissipation) is sharpest. Generally, driver work and relative differences of driven and undriven EP closely mirror the performance landscape. The system EP, derived from a generalized Liouville-equation estimator, and heat flow provide complementary diagnostics and metrics, which are most robust in the best-performing regime. These results extend prior expectations that dissipation matters for computation by identifying when and how it becomes predictive. They also relate inference power to innate dynamics, pointing to generic principles for physical computing and where EP offers a screening metric for reservoirs and other base substrates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析一个受驱动蜂群储层模型，研究了熵产生（EP）与计算能力之间的关系。研究表明，驱动功和驱动/未驱动熵产生的相对差异能密切反映预测性能的景观，系统熵产生和热流提供了互补的诊断指标，在最优性能区域最为稳健，从而揭示了耗散何时以及如何成为计算能力的预测指标。
AI.motivation: 主动物质基板持续消耗能量并产生熵，理论上熵产生（EP）可描述不可逆性和偏离平衡的程度，但尚不清楚其是否能追踪计算能力。作者旨在弥合这一概念性空白，探究EP是否与储层计算性能存在关联。
AI.method: 分析一个受驱动的蜂群储层模型，分别从相空间收缩计算系统EP、从热流计算浴EP，并将两者与Lorenz-63任务上的预测性能直接关联。通过力参数扫描，考察不同动力学状态下响应、耗散与性能之间的关系；系统EP通过广义Liouville方程估计量推导。
AI.result: （1）对驱动器响应最强且耗散最强的动力学区域与峰值性能重合；（2）该区域内，内在（最小耗散）与驱动传递热量（最大耗散）之间的动力学差异最为显著；（3）驱动功和驱动/未驱动EP的相对差异能密切反映性能景观；（4）系统EP与热流提供互补的诊断和度量，在最佳性能区域最为稳健。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果扩展了先前关于耗散对计算重要的预期，明确了耗散何时以及如何成为预测性指标。同时将推断能力与内在动力学联系起来，为物理计算提供了通用原则，并指出EP可作为储层及其他基础基板的筛选度量。

title: FedQML-Edge: Compact Quantum Feature Sketches for Communication-Constrained Roadside Federated Learning
summary: Roadside units (RSUs) supporting connected and autonomous vehicle corridors need compact models to decide when cooperative maneuvers should be rewarded, deferred, or disabled. Raw sensor streams and neural network weight checkpoints are poorly suited to bandwidth-limited, privacy-sensitive roadside learning. This paper presents $\texttt{FedQML-Edge}$, a federated quantum feature-sketching pipeline for traffic-stability gating. Each RSU constructs a traffic-state summary and sends circuit inputs to a quantum computer; Pauli expectations form a nonlinear sketch processed by a logistic classifier. Only classifier updates are shared with an aggregator, whose head supports reward gating. Raw observations, vehicle records, event traces, and quantum sketches remain private. We evaluate the method using NGSIM trajectories, SUMO predictive gating with sensing noise, and IBM Quantum hardware. On NGSIM, the Pauli sketch reduces test log loss by $14.4\%$ relative to the strongest matched classical sketch. On SUMO, it approaches larger MLPs in stable-window recall while using $7-28$ times less communication per round.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedQML-Edge，一种面向路侧单元（RSU）的联邦量子特征草图管道，用于交通稳定性门控决策。RSU构建交通状态摘要并发送电路输入至量子计算机，Pauli期望形成非线性特征由逻辑回归分类器处理，仅共享分类器更新以保护隐私。在NGSIM、SUMO和IBM Quantum硬件上验证，相比最强劲的经典草图，Pauli草图测试对数损失降低14.4%，同时通信量减少7-28倍。
AI.motivation: 支持车联网自动驾驶走廊的路侧单元需要紧凑模型来决定何时奖励、延迟或禁用协作操作，但原始传感器流和神经网络权重检查点不适合带宽受限、隐私敏感的分布式路侧学习场景。
AI.method: 提出FedQML-Edge联邦量子特征草图框架：每个RSU生成交通状态摘要并发送电路输入至量子计算机，通过Pauli期望值构建非线性特征草图，经逻辑分类器处理；仅分类器更新与聚合器共享，聚合器头部支持奖励门控。原始观测、车辆记录、事件轨迹和量子草图均保持私有。
AI.result: 在NGSIM轨迹数据上，Pauli草图相比最强的匹配经典草图将测试对数损失降低14.4%；在SUMO仿真中，稳定窗口召回率接近更大的MLP模型，同时每轮通信量减少7-28倍；并在IBM Quantum硬件上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: FedQML-Edge展示了联邦量子特征草图在路侧交通稳定性门控中的有效性，在保持隐私和带宽高效的同时达到与大型神经网络相近的召回性能，表明量子特征提取与联邦学习结合是资源受限路侧学习的有前景范式。

title: Analytical and Bootstrap Confidence Intervals of Double Machine Learning: Simulation studies and an application to rural-urban difference in obesity prevalence
summary: Double Machine Learning (DML) is a popular approach for treatment effect estimation in various settings, which allows a wide range of flexible machine learning methods to be used for nuisance parameter estimation while preserving valid inference. In practice, however, applied researchers must choose among many machine learning algorithms for nuisance models, and the impact of this choice on the variance estimation of DML is not well characterized. We conduct a comprehensive simulation study to compare the coverage probability of DML confidence intervals across different machine learning algorithms. In this study, we compare (1) analytical confidence intervals derived by DML theory versus (2) bootstrap confidence interval. We use a set of learners including ordinary least squares, LASSO, Random Forest, LightGBM, and Neural Networks under different data generation settings. We evaluate the performance across difference settings by bias, confidence interval width, and most importantly, coverage probability. Our results show substantial variability in coverage performance across analytical and bootstrap confidence intervals, highlighting that learner choice plays a critical role in reliable DML inference. Surprisingly, we find that in many settings, when sample size increases, the coverage probability of both DML analytical and bootstrap confidence interval decreases. We further investigate coverage probabilities using a real dataset on rural urban differences among U.S. counties. The real data analysis discovers that (1) the model performance still varies by the learner choices and (2) greater rurality has a statistically significant increasing effect on county level obesity prevalence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模模拟研究，系统比较了Double Machine Learning（DML）框架下不同机器学习算法（OLS、LASSO、Random Forest、LightGBM、Neural Networks）对置信区间覆盖率的影响，并将解析置信区间与bootstrap置信区间进行了对比。研究发现学习者选择对DML推断可靠性至关重要，且样本量增大时覆盖率反而下降的反直觉现象。真实数据分析表明更大程度的农村化对美国县级肥胖患病率具有统计显著的递增效应。
AI.motivation: DML是治疗效应估计的流行方法，允许使用灵活机器学习方法进行干扰参数估计的同时保持有效推断。然而在实际应用中，研究者必须在众多机器学习算法中做出选择，而这一选择对DML方差估计（进而影响置信区间覆盖率）的影响尚未被充分刻画。因此亟需系统性研究机器学习算法选择如何影响DML推断的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用全面的模拟研究方法，在不同数据生成设置下比较5种机器学习学习者（OLS、LASSO、Random Forest、LightGBM、Neural Networks）在DML框架下的表现。评估两种置信区间构建方式：(1)基于DML理论的解析置信区间，(2)bootstrap置信区间。性能指标包括偏差、置信区间宽度和覆盖率。此外，使用美国县级农村-城市差异的真实数据集进行验证分析。
AI.result: 模拟结果显示，不同学习者之间以及解析与bootstrap置信区间之间在覆盖率性能上存在显著差异。反直觉地发现，在许多设置下，样本量增大时DML解析和bootstrap置信区间的覆盖率反而下降。真实数据分析确认了模型性能因学习者选择而异，并发现更大程度的农村化对县级肥胖患病率具有统计显著的递增效应。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习学习者的选择在DML推断的可靠性中起着关键作用，研究者不能忽略算法选择对置信区间覆盖率的影响。传统认知中样本量增大应提高推断质量，但本研究发现覆盖率下降的反常现象，提示DML推断在实际应用中仍存在需要警惕的不稳定性。同时，农村化程度与肥胖率之间的正相关关系在美国县级层面得到实证支持。

title: Savi-Bhransha: Graph-Theoretic Dislocation-Loop Characterization in Crystals
summary: Dislocation loops govern the properties of crystalline materials, but extracting their detailed characteristics from atomistic simulations is difficult when loops are fragmented or embedded in compact defect debris. We present Savi-Bhransha, a graph-theoretic method that reconstructs interstitial and vacancy loops directly from local defect-displacement motifs, without constructing a global interface mesh.
