AI.result: 推导出最优保真度的闭式表达式；证明并行协议在一般量子超通道中仍然最优；得到查询复杂度n=Θ(d[(D-d)/ε+1])；给出电路复杂度O(poly(D,1/ε))的构造；多副本情形的最优保真度为1-kd(D-d)/n+o(n^{-1})，由基于估计的并行协议渐近达到；对于未知秩-r通道，若Kraus秩r为常数，查询复杂度最优至常数因子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整解决了未知等距通道复共轭的最优模拟问题，展示了并行协议的最优性，并将结果推广到多副本和一般量子通道情形，为相关量子Oracle问题的资源分析奠定了理论基础。

title: TerraNova: A Foundation Model for the Anthropocene
comment: 32 pages, 16 figures. Supplementary Information (full methodological specification, ablation programme, extended results, computational cost; 157 pages) available at the project page: https://carlosrodriguezpardo.es/projects/TerraNova/
summary: A defining problem of the Anthropocene is to model the physical Earth and human societies as one coupled system, yet no learned representation spans their observational breadth. We argue the obstacle is geometric: the physical Earth is measured as continuous fields that ignore political borders, whereas societies are reported for administrative units. Earth-system foundation models serve the first geometry; coupling it to the second has required lossy averaging over borders. We introduce TerraNova, a foundation model trained on 1,024 physical and societal records in their native geometries: 512 gridded Earth-system fields and 512 national indicators. Dedicated encoders represent location, country, time and task, cross-modal transformers fuse them into a shared spatiotemporal state, and a hypernetwork generates a per-query decoder whose evidential head returns a predictive distribution. Two contrastive objectives couple the representation: a population-weighted alignment between each country and coordinates in its territory, and one to pretrained geospatial embeddings carrying image-derived semantics. Read out through that decoder, the representation is competitive with purpose-built geospatial encoders while spanning axes they do not represent (time, oceans and uncertainty) and supporting country-level capabilities. The frozen backbone reconstructs dense fields from sparse observations and adapts to unseen variables in minutes on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TerraNova，一个能够统一物理地球与人类社会观测数据的全新基础模型。该模型在原生几何结构上训练1024个物理和社会记录（512个网格化地球系统场和512个国家指标），通过专用编码器、跨模态变换器和超网络生成解码器，实现跨网格与国家边界数据的统一建模。
AI.motivation: 人类世的核心挑战是将物理地球与人类社会建模为一个耦合系统，但现有的学习表示无法覆盖两者的观测广度。根本障碍在于几何不匹配：物理地球数据是连续场（忽略政治边界），而社会数据是按行政单元报告的。现有地球系统基础模型仅服务于前者，耦合后者需要通过有损的边界平均来实现。
AI.method: TerraNova采用多模态架构：1) 专用编码器分别表示位置、国家、时间和任务；2) 跨模态变换器将这些编码融合为共享的时空状态；3) 超网络为每个查询生成专用解码器，配以具有证据回归头的预测分布输出。训练中使用两个对比学习目标：一是各国与其境内坐标之间的人口加权对齐，二是与携带图像语义的预训练地理空间嵌入的对齐。
AI.result: 该表示在跨时间、海洋和不确定性等维度上，与传统专用地理空间编码器相比具有竞争力，同时支持国家层面的能力。冻结的主干网络可以从稀疏观测中重建稠密场，并能在消费级硬件上几分钟内适应未见过的变量。
AI.conclusion: TerraNova证明了消除网格场与国家指标之间几何鸿沟的可行性，为物理与社会数据的统一建模提供了首个学习表示，且具有良好的可适应性。

title: On the Origin of Beyond-Classical Advantage in the Parity-Permutation Problem
summary: We investigate the task of identifying the parity (odd vs even) of an unknown permutation applied to $n$ particles. Classically, using fewer than $n$ distinct labels per particle limits the success probability to random guessing, whereas quantum mechanics, exploiting entanglement in both preparation and measurement, accomplishes the task perfectly with as few as $\big\lceil \sqrt{n}\big\rceil$ levels per particle [\href{https://doi.org/10.1103/yhyv-xnwq}{PRL {\bf 135}, 260603 (2025)}]. We show that even without entangled preparation, quantum theory still offers a probabilistic advantage over classical strategies. Moreover, such product preparations yield perfect success in locally quantum theories, where elementary systems are quantum but their composition follows the minimal tensor product structure of generalized probabilistic theories (GPTs). We further identify GPT models that accomplish the task with certainty without requiring entanglement either at the preparation stage or at the measurement stage. Our central result establishes that the linear dimension of the elementary systems, rather than entanglement, is the fundamental resource governing the existence of probabilistic advantage in the permutation parity problem. In particular, below the required dimension threshold, no amount of entanglement can improve upon the random-guessing limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未知排列的奇偶性识别任务。经典方法在粒子标签数少于n时只能随机猜测，而量子力学利用纠缠态可在每粒子仅√n个能级时完美完成任务。论文证明即使没有纠缠制备，量子理论仍提供优于经典的概率优势；在局部量子理论（采用最小张量积结构的GPT）中，乘积制备可完美成功。核心结论是：基本系统的线性维度（而非纠缠）才是决定排列奇偶性问题中概率优势存在与否的根本资源。
AI.motivation: 探索排列奇偶性识别任务中量子优势的根本来源，厘清纠缠与系统维度（希尔伯特空间维数）在该任务中各自扮演的角色，并考察更广义的概率理论（GPTs）框架下的表现。
AI.method: 通过对比经典策略、标准量子策略（含纠缠制备与纠缠测量）、无纠缠制备的量子策略，以及采用最小张量积结构的局部量子理论（GPT框架）中的策略，系统分析该任务的成败条件，建立维度阈值与概率优势之间的严谨关系。
AI.result: (1) 即使不使用纠缠制备，量子理论仍能获得优于经典的几率优势；(2) 在最小张量积GPT框架下，乘积制备即可实现完美成功率；(3) 存在无需准备或测量阶段纠缠的GPT模型也能完美完成任务；(4) 核心结论：基本系统的线性维度是决定概率优势存在的根本资源，低于维度阈值时即使无限纠缠也无法超越随机猜测极限。
AI.conclusion: 排列奇偶性问题的量子优势本质上由基本系统的线性维度决定，而非纠缠资源本身。这一发现重新定义了纠缠与维度在量子信息处理任务中的相对重要性，为在广义概率理论框架下理解量子优势基础提供了新视角。

title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
summary:
Imitation learning (IL)---training an agent to replicate expert behavior from demonstrations---underpins applications from robotics to language model training. Standard approaches such as Behavior Cloning (BC) are known to suffer from compounding errors and performance plateaus, particularly when the learner cannot perfectly represent the expert's policy (as is typical, e.g., in distillation). Two interventions are widely understood empirically to improve performance: querying the expert interactively along the learner's own trajectories, and using value function estimation en route to generating a policy rather than directly fitting the expert's full action distribution.
  We investigate the nature of these improvements and their potentially surprising interplay. Our main finding is that expert interaction relaxes the representational demands on the learner: one only needs a model capable of realizing the expert's value function, bypassing the (often stricter) requirement of realizing the expert's policy itself. Concretely, we introduce OVI, an interactive on-policy IL algorithm that is statistically efficient whenever the learner can represent the expert's value function and computationally efficient given access to a linear maximization oracle. We complement this with a negative result showing that interaction is necessary. Namely, without stronger assumptions beyond expert-value realizability alone, any offline IL algorithm must scale with the complexity of the expert policy class. Our findings bear out empirically. OVI outperforms offline policy-based (BC), interactive policy-based (DAgger), and offline value-based IL methods, with the largest gains when the learner network is substantially less expressive than the expert's.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种交互式在线模仿学习算法OVI，其核心发现是：专家交互可以放宽学习者的表征需求——只需能表达专家的价值函数而非策略本身即可实现统计高效。同时给出理论下界证明离线算法在仅满足价值可实现性时需要依赖策略类复杂度，并通过实验验证OVI在多种设置下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习（IL）在机器人到语言模型训练等场景中至关重要，但行为克隆（BC）等标准方法因复合误差和性能瓶颈而受限。实践中两种干预手段（交互式查询专家、使用价值函数估计）被广泛认为能提升性能，但其内在机理及两者间的关系尚未被深入理解。本文旨在揭示这些改进的本质，特别是专家交互如何放松学习者的表征要求。
AI.method: 本文引入OVI（On-policy Value-based Interaction）算法。该算法采用交互式on-policy策略：在学习者自身轨迹上查询专家，并以专家价值函数的可实现性（realizability）代替策略可实现性作为核心假设。算法在统计上利用价值函数的可表达能力实现高效学习，在计算上通过线性最大化预言机（linear maximization oracle）保证计算效率。此外，作者还构造了理论下界，证明在没有更强假设的情况下，离线IL算法必须依赖专家策略类的复杂度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：OVI在离线基于策略的BC、交互式基于策略的DAgger以及离线基于价值的IL方法上均表现更优，尤其是在学习者网络表达能力远弱于专家策略的情况下，OVI的优势最为显著。该结果验证了理论分析，即专家交互能放松表征要求，使得仅需实现专家价值函数即可高效学习。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上阐明专家交互在IL中的核心作用——它降低了学习者的表征负担，使价值函数可实现性成为充分条件；同时通过负面结果表明这种交互在无更强假设下是必要的。这一发现为实际IL系统设计（尤其在模型蒸馏等表达能力受限场景）提供了新原则：当策略难以精确复现时，转向学习价值函数并辅以交互式查询是更优路径。

title: Numerical Optimization of Two-Qubit Gates in Silicon Flip-Flop Qubit Arrays under Electrical Control
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. The numerical simulator "FlipFlopQSim" developed for this work and used to generate the results presented in this article is publicly available at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21669875
summary: Silicon-based donor flip-flop qubits offer a promising path toward scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing by combining the long coherence times of nuclear spins with fast, fully electrical control and long-range dipole-dipole coupling between qubits. However, realizing high-fidelity entangling operations in this platform remains challenging. The entangling interaction is intrinsically coupled to electron orbital dynamics, which can lead to leakage into non-computational states and unwanted phase accumulation. Furthermore, in multi-qubit architectures, residual dipolar couplings from spectator qubits distort the effective interaction landscape. In this work, we employ a numerical simulation framework, FlipFlopQSim, that models the spin-orbital dynamics of interacting flip-flop qubits to extract effective logical operations from realistic electrical control pulses. Using Makhlin invariants, we map the entangling landscape generated by electrically controlled dipole-dipole interactions and identify operating regions locally equivalent to canonical two-qubit gates, such as $\sqrt{iSWAP}$ and $iSWAP$. We then optimize the control parameters of physically realizable, electrically driven $R_z$ rotations to implement the necessary local corrections and maximize composite gate fidelity. Finally, we scale our analysis to multi-qubit registers with various geometries and connectivity patterns to evaluate spectator-induced distortions. Our results demonstrate that high-fidelity entangling operations cannot be optimized in isolation; rather, they require a co-design approach that simultaneously optimizes pulse control, local phase compensation, and physical device geometry. This work provides a robust numerical framework for assessing the scalability of electrically controlled silicon quantum processors and outlines key design principles for robust multi-qubit gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FlipFlopQSim数值仿真框架，用于模拟硅基翻转-翻转（flip-flop）量子比特的自旋-轨道动力学，通过马赫林不变量映射纠缠景观，优化电控脉冲实现高保真度两量子比特门，并将其扩展到多量子比特寄存器以评估旁观者引起的失真效应。
AI.motivation: 硅基供体翻转-翻转量子比特结合了核自旋的长相干时间、快速全电控制及长程偶极-偶极耦合，是实现可扩展容错量子计算的 promising 路径。然而，实现高保真度的纠缠操作面临两大挑战：纠缠相互作用与电子轨道动力学固有耦合导致泄漏和非计算态及不期望相位积累；多量子比特架构中旁观者量子比特的残余偶极耦合扭曲有效相互作用景观。
AI.method: 开发FlipFlopQSim数值仿真框架，模拟相互作用的翻转-翻转量子比特的自旋-轨道动力学，从实际电控脉冲提取有效逻辑操作。利用Makhlin不变量映射电控偶极-偶极相互作用产生的纠缠景观，识别与规范两量子比特门（如√iSWAP和iSWAP）局部等价的运行区域。优化物理上可实现的电驱动R_z旋转的控制参数，以实现必要的局域修正并最大化复合门保真度。扩展到多量子比特寄存器，研究不同几何结构和连接模式下的旁观者诱导失真。
AI.result: 结果表明高保真度纠缠操作无法孤立优化，需要同时优化脉冲控制、局域相位补偿和物理器件几何结构的协同设计方法。该框架提供了评估电控硅量子处理器可扩展性的稳健数值工具，并确立了多量子比特门稳健实现的关键设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为电控硅量子处理器的可扩展性评估提供了稳健的数值框架，并强调了脉冲控制、局域相位补偿与器件几何三者的协同优化是实现高保真度多量子比特门的必要条件。

title: Differentially Private Nonparametric Modal Learning with Applications to Regression and Clustering
summary: Density modes provide a localized and interpretable summary of multimodal distributions, but their estimation under rigorous differential privacy constraints remains largely unexplored. We study differentially private recovery of density modes for multivariate distributions under local smoothness, curvature, and separation conditions. We propose DP-GRAMS, a mean-shift inspired method that performs noisy ascent on a differentially private score estimator. Assuming the density belongs locally to a Hölder class with smoothness parameter $β> 2$, our score estimator uses bias-reducing higher-order kernels, and then enforces privacy in the gradient ascent steps via gradient clipping and calibrated Gaussian noise. A private initialization scheme combines a density-aware utility with a suppression rule and, with $k\asymp M\log n$ draws over a public $h_{\mathrm{DAP}}$-grid and suppression radius $ρ_{\mathrm{init}}\asymp (\log n)^{-1/d}$, achieves high-probability coverage of the modal basins by successively suppressing selected local neighborhoods in competitive regions, while correlated noise across multiple starts enables joint release under a single $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy guarantee. We prove that all population modes are recovered with high probability and establish asymptotic error rates of the form $O\!\left((\tfrac{\log n}{n})^{\frac{2(β-1)}{d+2β}}\right) + O\!\left((\tfrac{\mathrm{polylog}(n,δ)}{n^2\varepsilon^2})^{\frac{β-1}{d+β}}\right)$. We also provide minimax lower bounds for private mode estimation, and show that our estimators are nearly optimal, up to a logarithmic factor in the MSE. We present two natural extensions: DP-PMS, a private modal-regression method, and DP-GRAMS-C, a clustering pipeline. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate favorable privacy-utility trade-offs relative to common baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在严格差分隐私约束下，多元分布密度模式（mode）的估计问题。提出了DP-GRAMS方法，一种基于均值漂移思想的隐私保护梯度上升算法，通过使用高阶核归约偏差的私有得分估计器，配合梯度裁剪和高斯噪声实现隐私保护。同时设计了基于密度感知效用和抑制规则的私有初始化方案，实现了模态盆地的高概率覆盖。文中证明了所有总体模式可以高概率恢复，并建立了渐近误差率，同时给出了极小极大下界，展示了估计器在MSE意义上（至多对数因子）接近最优。还扩展了DP-PMS（私有模态回归）和DP-GRAMS-C（聚类流水线）两种变体，实验验证了良好的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 密度模式为多峰分布提供了局部化和可解释的总结，但在严格差分隐私约束下的估计问题此前鲜有研究。现有的私有密度估计方法通常无法直接用于模式恢复，且模式估计本身在隐私条件下的理论基础（如极小极大下界）尚属空白。本文旨在填补这一空缺，建立私有模式估计的理论基础。
AI.method: DP-GRAMS采用均值漂移启发式方法，在私有得分估计器上执行带噪声的梯度上升。具体而言：(1) 在局部Hölder光滑性β>2条件下，使用偏差降低的高阶核构建得分估计器；(2) 通过梯度裁剪和校准高斯噪声在梯度上升步骤中强制实施隐私；(3) 私有初始化方案结合密度感知效用与抑制规则，在公共网格上通过k≍Mlog n次采样和抑制半径ρ_init≍(logn)^{-1/d}逐步抑制竞争区域中的局部邻域以实现模态盆地覆盖；(4) 多次启动间的相关噪声允许在单一的(ε,δ)-差分隐私保证下进行联合发布。同时给出极小极大下界分析及两种扩展（DP-PMS、DP-GRAMS-C）。
AI.result: 证明了所有总体模式以高概率被恢复，并建立了渐近误差率：O((logn/n)^{2(β-1)/(d+2β)}) + O((polylog(n,δ)/(n²ε²))^{(β-1)/(d+β)})。提供了私有模式估计的极小极大下界，证明估计器在MSE意义上（至多对数因子）近乎最优。在合成和真实数据上的大量实验展示了相对于常见基线的有利隐私-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了私有多元密度模式估计的第一个系统性理论框架，提出的DP-GRAMS方法在理论上保证了模式的高概率恢复和近乎最优的收敛速率，并通过实验验证了实际有效性。同时提供了两种自然扩展（私有模态回归和私有聚类流水线），为后续研究开辟了方向。

title: InferQ: A Database-Oriented Benchmark for Quantum Circuits Simulation
comment: Accepted for presentation at ACM SIGMOD 2027 and publication in the Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (PACMMOD). This arXiv version is an extended technical report that includes the complete appendix
summary: Recent work suggests that relational database management systems (RDBMSs) can execute quantum circuit simulation by compiling the simulation into SQL workloads (primarily join-and-aggregate tensor contractions). While early results are promising, they largely focus on a narrow set of highly structured circuits and offer limited support for systematic database research, such as query optimization, physical design, and engine-level evaluation across a broad range of circuits. We present InferQ, a database-oriented benchmark for quantum circuit simulation. InferQ generates general, compositional circuits by assembling subcircuits from a set of circuit templates, emits each simulation task as an RDBMS-ready SQL workload, and extracts circuit and query features (static, graph, SQL, and dynamic) for workload characterization. InferQ also releases a large dataset of 202,975 circuits online, with a web-based viewer to support searching, filtering, and downloading circuits and feature records. In experiments across RDBMS engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, and Umbra) and the widely used Qiskit Aer simulator, we find that RDBMSs achieve better peak memory usage than Qiskit Aer on more than 50% of the circuits generated by InferQ. Moreover, using InferQ features, lightweight machine learning models (linear and tree-based models) can accurately predict when SQL execution is preferable (with accuracy up to 95.3% for runtime and 97.4% for memory), enabling data-centric simulator selection and opening the door to principled optimization of SQL-based quantum circuit simulation.

AI.tldr: InferQ是一个面向量子电路模拟的数据库基准测试工具，通过编译电路模拟为SQL工作负载并生成大量电路数据集（202,975个），支持工作负载特征提取和轻量级机器学习模型进行模拟器选择。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽然证明RDBMS可以执行量子电路模拟，但主要聚焦于少数结构化电路，缺乏系统性的数据库研究支持（如查询优化、物理设计、引擎级评估等），且缺乏覆盖广泛电路的基准测试。
AI.method: InferQ从电路模板组装通用组合电路，将每个模拟任务生成为RDBMS可执行的SQL工作负载，提取静态、图、SQL和动态四类特征用于工作负载表征，并发布包含202,975个电路的大型数据集及Web查看器。
AI.result: 在PostgreSQL、SQLite、DuckDB、Umbra和Qiskit Aer的实验中，RDBMS在超过50%的InferQ生成电路上实现了比Qiskit Aer更好的峰值内存使用；轻量级ML模型（线性与树模型）能以高达95.3%（运行时）和97.4%（内存）的准确率预测何时更适合用SQL执行模拟。
AI.conclusion: InferQ为基于SQL的量子电路模拟提供了全面的基准测试平台，验证了RDBMS在大规模电路模拟中的内存优势，并通过特征驱动的机器学习方法实现了数据驱动的模拟器智能选择，为SQL量子模拟的优化开辟了路径。

title: Transpiler Autotuning with Predictive Models for Quantum Circuit Optimization
summary: Quantum software engineering is an emerging research field focusing on efficiently embedding the quantum programming paradigm into existing software ecosystems. A key aspect of this field is the realization of quantum algorithms using gate-based programming and the subsequent low-level optimization of the resulting quantum circuits, a process that is commonly performed by so-called transpilation pipelines. One significant challenge in these pipelines is determining which optimizations to apply to a given circuit. This decision is usually based on fixed default configurations that are uniformly applied to all circuits, frequently resulting in missed opportunities for more aggressive circuit optimization. In this work, we tackle this challenge by applying autotuning with supervised machine learning to develop an automated method for selection of transpiler passes. To train our machine-learning models, we employ feature-model based sampling to generate a representative dataset that examines how different combinations of Qiskit transpiler passes perform across thousands of circuits drawn from the state-of-the-art benchmarking suite MQT Bench. Using these data, we build a predictive model extension for the Qiskit transpilation pipeline that uses a machine learning model to automatically select combinations of transpiler passes aiming to achieve a maximum reduction in two-qubit gates. Our empirical evaluation shows that the combinations selected by our model are never outperformed by Qiskit's optimization levels, achieve on average an additional 19.1$\%$ - 32.4$\%$ reduction in two-qubit gates, and for some circuits finds reductions of up to $95.8\%$ in cases where Qiskit achieves no reduction at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于监督机器学习和自动调优的方法，用于自动选择Qiskit量子电路转译管线中的pass组合，以最大化减少双量子比特门的数量。实验表明该方法比Qiskit默认优化级别平均多减少19.1%-32.4%的双量子比特门，某些电路可达95.8%的额外减少。
AI.motivation: 量子转译管线中优化策略的选择通常依赖固定默认配置，对所有电路统一应用，导致错失更激进的电路优化机会。需要一个自动化的方法来智能选择转译器pass。
AI.method: 采用自动调优与监督机器学习相结合的方法。利用基于特征模型的采样生成了代表性数据集，涵盖数千个来自MQT Bench基准测试套件的电路，评估不同Qiskit转译pass组合的性能。基于这些数据构建了一个预测模型扩展，集成到Qiskit转译管线中，通过机器学习模型自动选择转译pass组合，以最大化双量子比特门的减少。
AI.result: 经验评估表明，模型选择的pass组合从未被Qiskit优化级别超越，平均额外实现19.1%-32.4%的双量子比特门减少，某些电路在Qiskit无法实现任何减少的情况下仍可达到95.8%的减少率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了机器学习驱动的自动调优方法在量子转译管线中的有效性，为量子软件工程中电路优化策略的自动化选择提供了可行方案，能够显著超越传统固定默认配置的性能。

title: Entanglement in bipartite systems with symmetry: coupled chaotic kicked Bose-Hubbard systems
summary: We investigate the average eigenstate entanglement in a bipartite many-body system which exhibits a breaking of two local conservation laws into a global conserved quantity. Such a setting is realized by the particle number conservation in Bose-Hubbard systems. We devise a corresponding random matrix model which captures the universal features of this symmetry breaking and allows for applying powerful random matrix methods. By combining the concept of symmetry resolved entanglement with perturbation theory for quantum chaotic systems we obtain a universal entanglement transition depending on a single fundamental parameter. Furthermore, the symmetry resolved entanglement allows for separating the genuine entanglement from the part which originates from the conserved quantity. This latter contribution is quantified by the number entropy. For this it is shown that the symmetry breaking generates a localization of the eigenstates due to a banded structure of the time-evolution operator. By extrapolating the results beyond the perturbative regime we obtain an analytic description of the full transition.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在双部分多体系统中，当两个局域守恒律被破缺为一个全局守恒量时（如Bose-Hubbard系统中的粒子数守恒），平均本征态纠缠的变化规律。通过构建相应的随机矩阵模型并联合对称性分解纠缠和量子混沌微扰理论，发现一个由单一基本参数控制的普适纠缠转变，并给出了完整转变的解析描述。
AI.motivation: 理解多体量子系统中守恒律破缺对本征态纠缠结构的影响，特别是当两个局域守恒量合并为一个全局守恒量时的普遍特征。以往的研究主要关注局域守恒量对纠缠的影响，而守恒律破缺如何重塑本征态纠缠结构尚缺乏统一的普适理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建一个能够捕捉该对称性破缺普适特征的随机矩阵模型；2) 结合对称性分解纠缠（symmetry resolved entanglement）与量子混沌系统的微扰理论进行分析；3) 利用数熵（number entropy）将源自守恒量的纠缠贡献与内在纠缠分离；4) 通过将微扰结果外推到非微扰区域，获得完整纠缠转变的解析描述。
AI.result: 得到了一个由单一基本参数控制的普适纠缠转变。对称性破缺导致时间演化算符呈现带状结构，从而使本征态发生局域化。数熵能够量化源自守恒量的纠缠贡献，成功将这部分与真正的纠缠分离。
AI.conclusion: 守恒律从局域破缺为全局的对称性变化会引发本征态纠缠的普适转变，其完整过程可通过解析方法描述；对称性分解纠缠思想为区分不同来源的纠缠提供了有效工具。

title: Towards the Characterization of Logical Errors in Distributed Lattice Surgery
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE 2026)
summary: Distributed quantum computing offers a scalable alternative to monolithic quantum processors by networking smaller quantum modules through shared entangled pairs. A central challenge in this setting is that inter-module quantum operations are typically noisier than intra-module local gates, which introduces additional noise into the system. In this work, we analyze distributed lattice surgery under heterogeneous noise conditions, focusing in particular on the merge operation as one of its fundamental subroutines. Specifically, we discuss the XX merge operation between two rotated surface-code patches hosted on two different quantum processors. We characterize logical errors in the resulting H-shaped spacetime diagram and estimate thresholds using a minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) decoder. We use a phenomenological noise model and derive distinct bulk and seam error rates to approximate a circuit-level noise model that includes contributions from local CNOT gates, noisy entangled pairs, idle errors, and readout errors. Our results provide practical insights into selecting the optimal surface-code distance, establishing target local-gate fidelities, and determining the tolerable entangled-pair fidelity required for logical operations in a distributed architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了分布式量子计算中分布式晶格手术（lattice surgery）在异质噪声条件下的性能，重点研究了两个不同量子处理器上的旋转表面码补丁之间的XX合并操作，并通过最小权完美匹配（MWPM）解码器表征逻辑错误和估计阈值。
AI.motivation: 分布式量子计算是替代单片量子处理器的可扩展方案，通过共享纠缠对连接小型量子模块。但模块间量子操作通常比模块内局部门噪声更大，引入额外噪声。需要分析异质噪声条件下分布式晶格手术的性能，以指导实际架构设计。
AI.method: 聚焦两个不同量子处理器上旋转表面码补丁之间的XX合并操作，对生成的H形时空图进行逻辑错误表征。使用现象学噪声模型，推导出不同的体（bulk）和接缝（seam）错误率，以近似包含局部CNOT门、噪声纠缠对、空闲错误和读出误差的电路级噪声模型。通过MWPM解码器估计阈值。
AI.result: 得到了异质噪声条件下分布式晶格手术的阈值估计，并为实际部署提供了指导性结论，包括最优表面码距离的选择、目标局部门保真度的设定，以及逻辑操作所需的可容忍纠缠对保真度。
AI.conclusion: 研究为分布式量子架构中逻辑操作的工程设计提供了实用见解，有助于在表面码距离、局部门保真度和纠缠对保真度之间进行权衡决策。

title: Chiral magnons for spin-qubit state transfer
summary: We propose a protocol where chiral magnons mediate a state transfer between two distant spin qubits. The protocol is implemented by varying the coupling between the spin qubits and the magnons in time, such that an arbitrary state is transferred from one qubit to the other. The modulation of the coupling is performed such that the two-spin-qubit state is kept as a dark state of the magnon bath, bypassing the associated losses. We show that the protocol can be realized on a hybrid system composed of two nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers coupled to the nonreciprocal and chiral magnon modes of an yttrium iron garnet (YIG) stripe. We propose two methods to achieve the time modulation of the NV-magnon coupling: i) the NV-magnet distance of both NV centers is varied; ii) the external magnetic field and the NV-magnet distance of one NV center are varied. We evaluate the implementability of both methods numerically, including the constraints on the temperature, and the dephasing time and minimal lifetime of the spin qubits required for high-fidelity state transfer. We find that using realistic experimental parameters, a state transfer between NV centers at a distance of several microns can be achieved with a fidelity $\gtrsim 0.95$. Our findings expand the toolbox of magnonics for quantum information purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用手性磁振子作为媒介，在两个远距离自旋量子比特（NV色心）之间实现高保真度任意量子态转移的协议。通过时变调控NV中心与YIG条纹中非互易手性磁振子模式的耦合，将双自旋系统保持在磁振子浴的暗态中，从而规避损耗。数值评估了两种时变调制方案，在真实实验参数下可实现距离数微米的NV中心间保真度≳0.95的态转移。
AI.motivation: 量子信息处理需要实现远程自旋量子比特之间的相干态转移，但直接耦合受距离限制，而使用磁振子作为介导通道又面临系统损耗问题。现有方法缺乏对手性磁振子用于量子态传输及损耗规避的系统方案，因此需要设计一种利用磁振子暗态实现低损耗高保真度远程量子态转移的协议。
AI.method: 提出利用手性磁振子在两个NV色心间介导态转移的协议。核心方法是时变调制NV-磁振子耦合，使双自旋态始终保持为磁振子浴的暗态（对非互易手性模式零衰减），从而绕过损耗。具体通过两种方式实现调制：(i)同时改变两个NV中心与磁体距离；(ii)改变外磁场及一个NV中心与磁体距离。并对两种方案进行数值评估，考虑温度、退相干时间及自旋量子比特最小寿命等约束条件。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，在现实可行的实验参数下，NV中心间距为数微米时，状态转移保真度可达到≳0.95。两种提出的调制方案均可行，且满足温度、退相干时间及量子比特寿命等实验约束条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将手性磁振子引入量子态长程传输领域，提出了利用暗态规避磁振子损耗的有效策略，扩展了磁振子学在量子信息处理中的应用工具箱，为分布式量子计算和量子网络中的远程自旋量子比特互联提供了新的可行途径。

title: Fisher-Orthogonal Memory in Quantum Reservoir Computing
summary: Quantum reservoir computing processes temporal information through driven many-body dynamics, but its performance is ultimately limited by how accurately past inputs can be extracted from finite measurements. Here we formulate this limitation as a local multiparameter estimation problem and introduce a delay-space quantum Fisher information matrix to quantify the distinguishability of memory traces. This perspective identifies Fisher-orthogonal memory as a measurement-efficient design principle: different delays should perturb the reservoir state along statistically independent directions. We first analyze the single-qubit limit using the Gill--Massar bound, revealing an optimal write-store-routing trade-off. Guided by this structure, we construct solvable multi-qubit reservoirs based on Clifford routing orbits and Singer-cycle Pauli algebra. The resulting dynamics yield diagonal, analytically programmable Fisher memory matrices with controlled dissipation profiles. Under finite-shot local Pauli readout, these reservoirs retain sharp memory windows and substantially improve over optimized random Ising reservoirs for both linear delay reconstruction and nonlinear product-delay tasks. The nonlinear advantage is traced to second-order response channels that inherit the same Pauli-routing structure. Our results provide an analytically controlled route toward measurement-efficient quantum reservoir computing.

AI.tldr: 本文从多参数估计的视角将量子储备池计算的记忆限制形式化为延迟空间量子Fisher信息矩阵，并提出"Fisher正交记忆"作为测量高效的设计原则，基于Clifford路由轨道和Singer循环Pauli代数构造了可解析求解的多量子比特储备池。
AI.motivation: 量子储备池计算依赖驱动多体动力学处理时序信息，但其性能受限于从有限测量中提取过去输入信息的精度。现有方法缺乏系统化的设计原则来量化并优化这种记忆提取极限，尤其是在测量资源有限的情况下。
AI.method: 1) 将记忆限制形式化为局部多参数估计问题，引入延迟空间量子Fisher信息矩阵；2) 提出Fisher正交记忆原则（不同延迟应沿统计独立方向扰动储备池态）；3) 单量子比特极限下用Gill-Massar界分析写入-存储-路由的最优权衡；4) 基于Clifford路由轨道和Singer-cycle Pauli代数构造可解的multi-qubit储备池，得到对角化、可解析编程的Fisher记忆矩阵；5) 在有限次数局域Pauli测量下进行线性和非线性任务验证。
AI.result: 构造的储备池在有限测量下保持锐利记忆窗口，在线性延迟重建和非线性乘积延迟任务中均显著优于优化后的随机Ising储备池。非线性优势源于继承相同Pauli路由结构的二阶响应通道。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了通向测量高效量子储备池计算的解析可控路径，建立了Fisher信息理论与量子储备池设计之间的桥梁。

title: Non-Hermitian Quantum Nonlinear Optics with Single Photons
summary: Quantum nonlinear optics seeks to harness strong photon-photon interactions for scalable quantum technologies, although dissipative losses still pose a major barrier to near-unity conversion efficiency. Here, we bridge non-Hermitian physics with the quantum nonlinear domain by exploiting perfect absorption to identify and optimize few-photon nonlinear processes. We theoretically investigate two circuit QED systems, operating in the light-matter ultrastrong coupling regime. The first (i) enables simultaneous two-atom excitations by single photons, while the second (ii) realizes the strong coupling between a single-photon and a two-photon Fock states. We demonstrate that, since the strong optical nonlinearities cause quantum spectral features to emerge already at the level of linear response theory, the perfect absorption condition in $|S_{11}|$ enables near-deterministic single-photon down-conversion into (i) a qubit-qubit-correlated pair and (ii) a two-photon pair. We show that the conversion efficiency can be systematically optimized through experimentally accessible parameters, both linked to the emergence of Hermitian subspaces within the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonians. These findings position non-Hermitian engineering as a broadly applicable route to optimizing quantum devices at the single-photon level, even beyond circuit-QED platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非Hermitian物理学中的完美吸收条件，在超强耦合电路QED系统中实现了接近确定性的单光子下转换，包括单光子到两原子纠缠对和单光子到双光子Fock态对的高效转换，并通过有效非Hermitian Hamiltonian中的Hermitian子空间来系统优化转换效率。
AI.motivation: 量子非线性光学旨在利用强光子-光子相互作用实现可扩展的量子技术，但耗散损耗仍然是接近unity转换效率的主要障碍。作者希望将非Hermitian物理与量子非线性领域联系起来，利用完美吸收条件来识别和优化少光子非线性过程，以克服耗散带来的效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者理论研究了两个工作在光-物质超强耦合区的电路QED系统：(i) 实现单光子同时激发两个原子的系统；(ii) 实现单光子与双光子Fock态之间强耦合的系统。利用完美吸收条件|S11|来分析量子光谱特征，因为强光学非线性使得量子谱特征在线性响应层面就已出现。通过实验可调参数系统优化转换效率，其优化与有效非Hermitian Hamiltonian中Hermitian子空间的出现相关联。
AI.result: 完美吸收条件使得该方案能够实现接近确定性的单光子下转换：(i) 转换为量子比特-量子比特关联对，(ii) 转换为双光子对。转换效率可通过实验可调参数进行系统优化，且优化机制与有效非Hermitian Hamiltonian中Hermitian子空间的涌现密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 非Hermitian工程是优化单光子层面量子器件的一种广泛适用途径，不仅限于电路QED平台，可推广到其他量子技术平台。

title: Charging and Discharging a Hubbard-Holstein Quantum Battery: Specific Mechanisms and General Insights
summary: A Hubbard-Holstein dimer functions as a correlation-driven quantum battery, with ergotropy robustly stored, under some conditions, even in the presence of dissipation. We find that, although optimal work extraction can in principle recover all the stored energy, it requires unrealistically fine-tuned couplings. By contrast, a physically realizable protocol based on spectral matching between the battery and the load achieves substantial, albeit suboptimal, energy extraction. Our results identify a mechanism for quantum energy storage, provide a realistic route to work extraction that is amenable to machine-learning-based theoretical exploration, and suggest that quantum batteries may not be universally deployable: the microscopic mechanism responsible for storing energy can constrain the classes of systems able to efficiently extract it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Hubbard-Holstein二聚体作为关联驱动的量子电池，发现即使在耗散存在下也能稳健地存储ergotropy能量，并提出了基于谱匹配的物理可实现能量提取协议。
AI.motivation: 量子电池的实用化面临两个核心问题：(1)如何在耗散环境中稳健存储能量；(2)如何实现物理上可行的高效能量提取。虽然理论上最优功提取可以恢复所有储存能量，但需要不切实际的精细调谐耦合参数，因此需要探索现实的提取路线。
AI.method: 以Hubbard-Holstein二聚体为模型系统，分析其作为关联驱动量子电池的储能特性；比较最优功提取与基于电池-负载间谱匹配的物理可实现协议在能量提取效率上的差异，并讨论了该系统对机器学习辅助理论探索的适用性。
AI.result: 研究发现最优功提取在原理上可恢复全部储存能量，但需精细调谐的耦合；而基于谱匹配的协议虽然只能实现次优的能量提取，却在物理上可实现，能够获得可观的（虽非最优的）能量提取效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了量子能量存储的微观机制，提供了可实现的功提取途径，并指出量子电池可能并非普遍适用——负责存储能量的微观机制可能限制能够高效提取能量的系统类别范围。

title: Algebraic Speedups for Exact Inversion of Hamiltonian Evolutions
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures; 27-page Supplemental Material included as an ancillary file
summary: Deterministic exact inversion of an arbitrary $d$-dimensional unitary requires {$Θ(d^2)$} coherent forward calls in the worst case. We ask how this cost changes for Hamiltonian evolution $U(x)=\exp(i\sum_j x_jH_j)$ when the generators are known but the parameters are hidden. For one-parameter families with a fixed eigenbasis, we show that additive relations among the distinct eigenvalues determine the optimal query number exactly, and we construct the corresponding inversion protocol. For general families, we prove that repeated symmetry sectors do not affect the exact query complexity and give an automatic construction for combining inverses from inequivalent active sectors. We also give a sufficient phase-alignment condition under which family-specific structure can reduce the query number. These results establish structure-dependent bounds for reversing the unknown dynamics arising in Tavis-Cummings out-of-time-order correlator protocols, collective-spin echo verification, and passive multimode links, without requiring prior knowledge or explicit estimation of the underlying coupling strengths.

AI.tldr: 本文研究哈密顿演化U(x)=exp(iΣx_jH_j)在生成元已知但参数隐藏时的精确逆查询复杂度，证明单参数族最优查询数由不同特征值间的加法关系精确决定，并证明重对称扇区不影响精确查询复杂度，同时给出扇区间逆的自动组合构造及相位对齐条件。
AI.motivation: 任意d维酉矩阵的确定性精确求逆最坏情况下需要Θ(d²)次相干前向调用，但实际应用中演化常由已知生成元的哈密顿量驱动，仅参数未知。作者希望利用这一族级结构信息，降低求逆的查询复杂度，从而为Tavis-Cummings OTOC协议、集体自旋回波验证、被动多模链路等场景提供无需先验估计耦合强度的精确逆方案。
AI.method: 作者从数学上分析单参数族固定特征基情形下，不同特征值之间的加法关系如何精确决定最优查询数；证明了一般族中重复对称扇区对精确查询复杂度无影响，并给出从不等价活动扇区的逆自动组合构造全局逆的方法；此外提出了充分相位对齐条件，在该条件下可利用族特定结构减少查询数。
AI.result: 建立了结构依赖的精确逆查询复杂度上界，覆盖了Tavis-Cummings OTOC协议、集体自旋回波验证和被动多模链路等场景，且无需对耦合强度进行先验知识或显式估计。
AI.conclusion: 哈密顿演化求逆的查询复杂度可由生成元的谱结构（特别是特征值间的加法关系与对称扇区结构）精确刻画，结构信息可作为降低最坏情况Θ(d²)成本的途径。

title: A Variational Framework for Time-Dependent Quantum Systems with Applications to Floquet Hamiltonians
summary: We introduce a variational framework for approximating the time-evolution operator $\hat{U}(t)$ within a physically motivated operator manifold, reformulating quantum dynamics as a tractable problem in operator space using stationary action principle. For periodically driven systems, the resulting approximate evolution operator directly yields an effective Floquet Hamiltonian, offering a non-perturbative alternative to conventional expansion-based methods. The framework is systematically improvable by enlarging the operator pool and naturally incorporates symmetries and physical constraints. When the operator manifold is chosen from the terms of a truncated Magnus expansion, the variational procedure effectively resums the Magnus series within the restricted space, significantly enhancing accuracy. We benchmark the approach on the driven Rabi model, the driven Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model, and the one-dimensional driven Ising chain, yielding effective Floquet Hamiltonians that are systematically more accurate than low-order Magnus expansions, particularly in regimes where the latter converge poorly, and illustrating applicability to systems with exponentially large Hilbert spaces. Although we focus here on Floquet systems, the formalism applies equally to generic time-dependent Hamiltonians, providing a versatile tool for non-equilibrium quantum dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个变分框架用于在物理驱动的算子流形中逼近时间演化算符，将量子动力学转化为算子空间中的可解问题。对于周期性驱动系统，该方法直接给出有效的Floquet哈密顿量，为传统微扰展开方法提供了非微扰替代方案。该框架可通过扩大算子池系统性地改进，并在算符流形选自截断Magnus展开项时，有效重求和Magnus级数，显著提升精度。
AI.motivation: 传统的Floquet系统处理方法（如Magnus展开）在参数进入低频或强驱动等收敛性较差的区域时精度不足，需要一种非微扰、可系统改进且能充分利用物理约束的方法来构建有效Floquet哈密顿量。
AI.method: 基于驻定作用量原理，在选定的物理算子流形中变分逼近时间演化算符Û(t)；对于周期驱动系统，逼近算符直接导出有效Floquet哈密顿量；算符池可自由选择（包括截断Magnus展开项），并通过扩大算子池系统性地提升精度；天然纳入对称性和物理约束。
AI.result: 在驱动Rabi模型、驱动Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick模型和一维驱动Ising链上进行了基准测试，结果表明该方法产生的有效Floquet哈密顿量系统性地优于低阶Magnus展开，特别是在Magnus展开收敛性差的区域；该框架可应用于希尔伯特空间指数增长的体系。
AI.conclusion: 该变分框架不仅适用于Floquet系统，也适用于一般的含时哈密顿量，为非平衡量子动力学提供了通用且多功能的工具。

title: Erasure surface code circuit without mid-circuit erasure checks
comment: 10 pages main text (5 figures), 9 pages appendix. See also separate Supplementary Materials
summary: Quantum error correction (QEC) codes can correct twice as many erasure errors as Pauli errors. Because of this scaling advantage, there is significant interest in developing qubits whose dominant error channel can be converted into erasures via mid-circuit erasure checks. However, such erasure checks come with hardware overhead in practice. End-of-the-line three-state readout, in which one simultaneously measures a qubit's erasure status and computational state, is an alternative to mid-circuit erasure checks that is generally simpler to implement. In this work, we systematically study the conditions required to enable erasure performance---the doubled error-correction capacity---in the surface code with and without mid-circuit erasure checks. We introduce the moonwalking surface code, the time-reversal of the walking surface code, as a zero-overhead circuit with superior handling of leakage and erasure. Specifically, we show that it enables erasure-like logical error rate scaling when combined with three-state measurement if leaked qubits cause two-qubit gates to be skipped and an appropriate decoder is used. Our decoder, based on a branch-and-bound algorithm, specifically incorporates the noise structure of the skip-gate leaked-qubit effect.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究表面码在有无中间电路擦除检查条件下实现擦除性能（纠错能力翻倍）所需的条件，提出"月步表面码"作为零开销电路，结合三态测量和基于分支定界算法的解码器，实现擦除级别的逻辑错误率缩放。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错码对擦除错误的纠错能力是对Pauli错误的两倍，具有显著优势。然而，通过中间电路擦除检查实现擦除错误通道会引入硬件开销。端到端三态读出（同时测量擦除状态和计算状态）作为更简单的替代方案，其实现擦除性能所需的条件尚未被系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出时间反演行走表面码的"月步表面码"，作为零开销电路；结合三态测量，并利用跳跃门泄漏量子比特效应（两比特门被跳过）；设计了基于分支定界算法的解码器，专门纳入跳跃门泄漏量子比特效应的噪声结构。
AI.result: 月步表面码在结合三态测量和适当的解码器时，能够实现擦除级别的逻辑错误率缩放，同时具备优越的泄漏处理能力，无需中间电路擦除检查即可获得擦除性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 无需中间电路擦除检查，仅通过三态读出、泄漏导致的跳跃门行为及专用解码器，即可在表面码中实现擦除性能，为降低硬件开销提供了新路径。

title: Quantum Algorithms for Modular Factorials
summary: We give a bounded-error quantum algorithm that, given a prime $p$, a divisor $q\mid(p-1)$, and an integer $0<n<p$, computes $n!\bmod p$ in expected time $\widetilde{O}(q^c+\sqrt{p/q})$ for some absolute constant $c\ge 1$. When $p-1$ has a divisor of size $q\approx p^{1/(2c+1)}$, this gives the exponent $c/(2c+1)<1/2$. To our knowledge, this is the first algorithm to break the exponent $1/2$ barrier for modular factorials under such a divisor promise. The main technical ingredient is a quantum algorithm that reconstructs the relevant Jacobi sum exactly in compact algebraic form, with polynomial dependence on $q$ and $\log p$. We further extend the same asymptotic bound to the computation of $n!\bmod p^2$, uniformly over $0\le n<p^2$. At $n=p-1$, this determines the Wilson quotient $\frac{(p-1)!+1}{p}\pmod p$. We conjecture that the condition $q\mid(p-1)$ is a technical limitation of the present method rather than an inherent obstruction, and that a uniform quantum algorithm exists for all primes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个有界误差量子算法，用于计算模素数的阶乘 n! mod p。在 p-1 存在约数 q 的条件下，算法期望时间为 Õ(q^c + √(p/q))，通过选择 q ≈ p^(1/(2c+1)) 可打破 1/2 指数障碍。算法核心是精确重构 Jacobi 和的量子方法，并扩展至模 p^2 情形以计算 Wilson 商。
AI.motivation: 模阶乘计算是数论中的基本问题，长期以来经典和量子算法在特定除数承诺条件下都无法突破指数 1/2 的障碍。作者旨在提出首个在该类除数承诺下打破 1/2 指数屏障的量子算法，并进一步推广至模 p^2 情形以计算 Wilson 商。
AI.method: 算法的关键技术是设计一个量子算法，以紧凑代数形式精确重构相关的 Jacobi 和，其复杂度对 q 和 log p 呈多项式依赖。基于此 Jacobi 和重构，结合除数 q|(p-1) 的承诺条件，在期望时间 Õ(q^c + √(p/q)) 内完成模阶乘计算；该框架可统一扩展到模 p^2 的计算。
AI.result: 当 p-1 存在大小约为 p^(1/(2c+1)) 的除数 q 时，算法取得指数 c/(2c+1) < 1/2 的复杂度，这是首个在该除数承诺下打破 1/2 指数屏障的结果。同时算法可扩展到 n! mod p^2（对所有 0≤n<p^2），在 n=p-1 时确定 Wilson 商 mod p。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为 q|(p-1) 这一条件是当前方法的技术限制而非本质障碍，并猜想存在对所有素数统一有效的量子算法。

title: Phase Sensitivity of Spectrally Multimode SU(1,1) Interferometers with Waveguide based Optical Parametric Amplifier
summary: We present a comprehensive framework for evaluating the phase sensitivity of spectrally multimode SU(1,1) interferometers probed with a coherent-vacuum input, under both number and homodyne detections. The optical parametric amplifiers (OPAs) are simulated using a periodically polled thin-film lithium niobate waveguide. The theoretical model incorporates the intrinsic multimode spectral nature of waveguide-based OPAs. Under the assumptions of identical OPAs and Schmidt-mode-independent phase shifts, we have shown that the multimode SU(1,1) interferometer is equivalent to a collection of independent single-mode interferometers in the Schmidt basis that operate in parallel, each associated with a Schmidt mode of the parametric process. We further present an optimized waveguide design based on asymmetric group-velocity matching to realize a practical OPA with nearly factorizable joint spectral amplitude (JSA). The Schmidt coefficients extracted from the numerically simulated JSA are incorporated into the theoretical model to evaluate the phase sensitivity. The results show that the sensitivity under a multimode condition depends strongly on the measurement scheme. For number detection, the degradation in sensitivity arises from the redistribution of the available nonlinear resource among the Schmidt modes, whereas homodyne detection exhibits an additional coherence penalty that can be substantially reduced by optimally shaping the local oscillator. Moreover, we show that the performance degradation can be to a large extent mitigated by optimizing the spectrum of the injected signal coherent state and, in the case of homodyne detection, the spectrum of the local oscillator. Altogether, this work provides a unified theoretical and numerical framework for analyzing and optimizing realistic multimode SU(1,1) interferometers with waveguide-based OPAs for quantum-enhanced sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全面的理论框架，用于评估在以相干-真空输入、数探测和零差探测条件下，光谱多模SU(1,1)干涉仪的相位灵敏度。基于周期性极化薄膜铌酸锂波导的光学参量放大器，作者证明了多模SU(1,1)干涉仪在特定假设下等价于Schmidt基中多个独立单模干涉仪的并联组合，并提出了基于非对称群速度匹配的波导优化设计以实现近似可分解的联合光谱幅度。研究发现数探测下灵敏度下降源于非线性资源在Schmidt模式间的重新分配，而零差探测还包含可被优化本振光形状削减的额外相干性惩罚。
AI.motivation: 实际波导型光学参量放大器（OPA）具有内在的多模光谱特性，这会影响基于SU(1,1)干涉仪的量子增强传感性能。此前缺乏一个综合考虑多模本质、测量方案和器件设计的统一理论框架来精确评估和优化相位灵敏度。
AI.method: 建立包含波导OPA多模光谱本质的理论模型，在相同OPA和Schmidt模式无关相位偏移假设下将多模干涉仪等效为Schmidt基中并联的独立单模干涉仪；基于非对称群速度匹配设计波导以获取近似可分解的联合光谱幅度；从数值模拟的JSA中提取Schmidt系数并融入理论模型，分别评估数探测和零差探测下的灵敏度，并通过优化注入信号相干态光谱和本振光光谱来缓解性能退化。
AI.result: 多模条件下灵敏度强烈依赖于测量方案：数探测的退化源于非线性资源在Schmidt模式间的重新分配；零差探测除资源分配外还引入额外的相干性惩罚，但可通过优化本振光形状大幅削减；优化注入信号相干态光谱（和零差探测下的本振光光谱）可在很大程度上缓解性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分析和优化使用波导型OPA的实际多模SU(1,1)干涉仪提供了统一的理论与数值框架，为量子增强传感应用中干涉仪的实用化设计提供了指导。

title: iSWAP maximises the second-moment spectral gap in random quantum circuits
summary: We prove that the $\mathrm{iSWAP}$ gate maximises the spectral gap of the Hermitian second-moment operator on every connected graph with at least three vertices, among all two-local unitary circuit ensembles. We further prove that the polyhedral cone defined by asymmetric four-point inequalities is invariant under the transpose of the $\mathrm{iSWAP}$ semigroup, yielding a componentwise comparison certificate for its positive Perron--Frobenius eigenvector. These results resolve a conjecture of Kong, Li, and Liu.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了iSWAP门在所有二局域幺正电路系综中，能够在任意至少含三个顶点的连通图上最大化Hermitian二阶矩算子的谱间隙；并进一步证明了由非对称四点不等式定义的多面体锥在iSWAP半群的转置下保持不变，从而得到了其正Perron–Frobenius特征向量的分量比较判据。这两个结果解决了Kong、Li和Liu提出的猜想。
AI.motivation: 研究二局域幺正电路系综的混合率（谱间隙）是量子信息与量子动力学的核心问题。作者旨在回答：在给定连通图上，哪种二局域门能最大化谱间隙（即最快的混合），并对此结构性结果提供严格的数学证明路径。
AI.method: 作者从两个角度推进证明：(1) 通过分析Hermitian第二矩算子，证明iSWAP门在所有二局域幺正系综中最大化谱间隙；(2) 引入由非对称四点不等式定义的多面体锥，证明该锥在iSWAP半群的转置下保持不变，利用Perron–Frobenius理论为iSWAP对应的特征向量提供分量比较（componentwise comparison）判据，从而完成猜想的证明。
AI.result: 成功证明了iSWAP门在任意至少三个顶点的连通图上最大化二阶矩算子的谱间隙（在二局域幺正系综中），并证明了不对称四点不等式锥的转置不变性，获得了iSWAP半群正Perron–Frobenius特征向量的分量比较判据，最终印证了Kong–Li–Liu猜想。
